body:
| Justice will be done.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3616%2E5257348%2EOwjKUP)
Derek —
Last week, when Donald Trump was arrested at the Fulton County Jail in Georgia, he tried to turn the moment into a spectacle.
A full motorcade. Timing the arrest during primetime television. Posting his mug shot as his return to Twitter.
It’s his classic media circus playbook — deflect and distract from the harsh reality: he is facing serious criminal charges for racketeering and conspiracy.
The evidence is strong: like the recorded phone call where he demanded the Georgia Secretary of State “find” 11,780 votes that didn’t exist.
Much of the evidence in the indictment comes from the January 6 Committee that I served on. **Derek, I led the hearing that revealed much of the evidence that is the basis of Trump’s fourth indictment.**
Now, Donald Trump is demanding special treatment in this trial — he didn’t want a mugshot (we know how that story ended).
And throughout this trial, he will certainly deflect and distract, trying to paint a different picture than the truth.
**But inside the courtroom, it’s not going to be reality TV. It’s going to be the reality of the justice system.**
And justice will be done.

body:
I want everyday people — folks who know how to take care of each other — to call the shots in our country.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
Before I ask you to add a donation of any amount toward our biggest end-of-month fundraising goal yet, I wanted to take some time to share a little bit more about the community I grew up in and why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
**Will you please let me explain?**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35865?refcode=em20230829-3651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3651%2E614464%2EYdjjze)
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri — and like so many other American families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, we went bankrupt.
Thanks to the generosity of our neighbors and people around town, we were able to get by. They took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, our neighbors brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
Eventually, our community helped me go to college. And after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they did for me and my family growing up.
But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found a neighborhood that had been picked for parts — our neighborhood corner store boarded up, our first family home bulldozed to the ground. **Now it’s an empty lot.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35865?refcode=em20230829-3651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3651%2E614464%2EYdjjze)
While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other — called the shots in this country.[And today, I’m asking for your support to make it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35865?refcode=em20230829-3651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3651%2E614464%2EYdjjze)**

**If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on this team.[Can you add a $10 donation right now so we’ll have the resources we need to get our message in front of voters and flip this U.S. Senate seat? I don’t take any money from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35865?refcode=em20230829-3651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3651%2E614464%2EYdjjze)**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

# BREAKING: ELDER TAKES ON THE CORRUPT RNC
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Dear Peter, We’re delivering a message to the Republican Establishment: we will not be ignored. **On Friday I announced that my campaign filed an**[**FEC complaint**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=586d8b7408&e=0be619cbaa)**against the RNC for unjustly excluding us from that debate stage.** [**THE RNC IS TRYING TO RIG THE PRIMARIES. WITH YOUR HELP, WE CAN TELL THEM WE THE PEOPLE WILL NOT BE SILENCED.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=84d2cf704f&e=0be619cbaa) **Remember: Our grassroots campaign qualified because thousands of hardworking Americans like you supported us**. Unlike some candidates who were allowed on that debate stage, our support was authentic. We didn’t use shady [gift card](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=9eace5ed11&e=0be619cbaa) or [commission schemes](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=da300a4d76&e=0be619cbaa) to buy your vote. I took my message directly to the American people, and you responded with **REAL** support for our campaign. **You told the RNC that you wanted Larry Elder on that debate stage, and they ignored your voice.** We can’t let them rig the game anymore. We can correct this grave injustice, but in order to win, I need your support. **Your donation of any size funds our efforts to ensure that all qualified candidates' voices are heard. The American people deserve a choice in this election, not the illusion of choice.** And when we succeed, and I’m installed on that debate stage, you can be confident that I’m up there FIGHTING FOR YOU. You already know my plan to restore America and to bring about a new Golden Age for our country, and now, millions more will hear it, too! Friends, this is the most important election of our lifetimes. We must take this country back from the Harris-Biden regime that is destroying our economy and making a mockery of the rule of law. I’m the only candidate in this race with the independence and courage to lead. I didn’t flinch during my gubernatorial run when the liberal media called me “the black face of white supremacy,” and I’m not going to stick to the pre-approved RNC script. By breaking down our political silos, we can unify America and WIN. As president, I will secure our border and stem the flow of people, drugs, and cartel activity that is destroying our communities. I will get the federal government out of the way so our economy can once again work for the American people. I will crack down on the activist prosecutors who are turning a blind eye to the violent crime that’s destroying our once great cities. And I will dismantle the CRT and DEI Industrial Complex that’s undermining racial harmony and our shared belief in the American dream. **[With your support we can tell the RNC that WE THE PEOPLE will not be silenced.
Your donations will ensure that we can do what is necessary to be included in the next debate. Please, give whatever you can today!](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=50ec8f447e&e=0be619cbaa)** Thank you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I want to share this with you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Team Stand for America, a joint fundraising
body:
Hi Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running
for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our
country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or
this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be
more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into
high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to
introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. Once
you've finished reading this, please consider making a
contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum
STRONG!

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I
have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable.
Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.

I
am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in
South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My
father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother
wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we
were there. But with each passing day, the community began to
look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who
we are: hard working people who held the same values they
cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into
smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every
day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After
graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I
decided to take a job working for my family's business that my
mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was
frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how
easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these
frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was:
"Don't complain. Do something about it."

So,
that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state
legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the
longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had
a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the
primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me,
and we won.

It was an honor to serve the people as
a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up
for the people of my district. When I fought for government
transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the
record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my
committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people
didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with
limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least
known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and
won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting
taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to
the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I
proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me"
sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the
backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we
were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the
UN didn't know what hit them.

I launched my campaign for President
over six months ago because our country is heading down a path of
doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will
rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the
people over the political class.

Now, I just completed my FIRST debate,
and I need a SURGE of support to keep the momentum strong in
order to continue sharing this message across America! It would
mean a lot to me if every single person reading this could send a
donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign
post-debate. >>

Your donation will not only show that
my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play
a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

Will you consider making a one-time
donation of any amount today in support of my fight to save
America?

CHIP IN $5

CHIP IN $25

CHIP IN $50

CHIP IN $150

CHIP IN ANY
OTHER AMOUNT

Friend, throughout my life, I've been
shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next
President. But in order to get there, I need your help to make it
across the finish line - starting right now.

Your support is what keeps our movement
thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

Nikki Haley

GET
YOUR HAT NOW

More About Nikki Haley

My name is Nikki Haley. I
want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for
President of the United States.

I'm running for President
because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an
America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I
want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President
as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and
his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means
something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President
for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got
married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy
a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and
shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he
doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my
daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to
experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream
has to offer.

I'm running for President
because we have a country to save!

I've seen that even on our
worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know
that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is
slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

As governor, I was dubbed a
"jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought
jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic
recovery.

At the UN I fought for
America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up
for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers
and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America
strong and proud because I've done it before. And I'll do it as
your next President.

As President, I'll
revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop
Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school
choice, and save America's future.

Will you join me today and
help me save our country?

name: Nikki Haley
subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |
---
| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I’m writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675176%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fkJNKUy9E%2fT5EBPVwMdxFw&sysid=1 "and how we can achieve
that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I’m running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675177%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zyY7obWcoEMok5B5F1BOJw&sysid=1 "It would mean the world to
know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch
in a generous contribution to my campaign today. ")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won’t win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we’ll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We’ll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won’t just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won’t be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675178%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IsyZ0FV%2fcJi6QxzfJ%2b8uDg&sysid=1 "It will take an
unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can’t complain about what you get in a general election if you don’t play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I’ve done it before, and I’ll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675179%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jhsYBmwT2NsI9Nm%2fwYnzIg&sysid=1 "Please consider chipping
in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue
to build a surge of momentum and save our country. ")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

name: Secure & Prosper
subject: You can learn from Rome’s history
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, We generally remember ancient Rome for its sprawling empire and powerful emperors. But overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through a far different form of government. Did you know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his Empire from the Roman Republic? The story of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success.
---
| | To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently released our free online course, **"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic." ** **[You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"](http://trk.secureandprosper.) when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. **
---
| [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---
| | And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a free color map of the Roman world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd](http://trk.secureandprosper.)** Learning the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way. That's why we produced **"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" **and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD. Before I go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online LearningHillsdale College
---

Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I’m writing to you today with a vision of that future – **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=150ca4112ccd477591edb28936858a5d&_e=FVANl9ivly50zGnpCNNL5-M90a5uKq5biHbTxfnkq5UGjMWyJeTYxOyzlIn802tyFfEfaO-nlakZwXReYhbP7Vg3p9pn2gYgPZ73PNkCIf_XRsL0Kw_VPyUyMjg7VDniBXTNR3mCtLC4CJIpsYDJC_fUtfocgk6c8rJa6-X_hMVebKVmLJ7K6iCqZk_ZTXoDXEveW2ZZbKrBh-i38v9qOCk9EzHscbq7oKjpbHNHHAhiLScFHnr-Qq_ixCglXHYrLFgt9-O0hBUAK_mPDr5bvK90n4t1C6YhwA6RpsW1HSVyptoLMGFfz65hude-lec3ZtOBOlwSLDMUspcvNApjabxBFCaWH5LHqdE7Qa0h0ngx_TqDSgI5rJIJGSnoTHjt "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America – _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America – _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world – _in freedom and peace._

**I’m running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=150ca4112ccd477591edb28936858a5d&_e=FVANl9ivly50zGnpCNNL5-M90a5uKq5biHbTxfnkq5UGjMWyJeTYxOyzlIn802tyFfEfaO-nlakZwXReYhbP7Vg3p9pn2gYgPZ73PNkCIf_XRsL0Kw_VPyUyMjg7VDniBXTNR3mCtLC4CJIpsYDJC_fUtfocgk6c8rJa6-X_hMVebKVmLJ7K6iCqZk_ZTXoDXEveW2ZZbKrBh-i38v9qOCk9EzHscbq7oKjpbHNHHAiAkbLoo-BywUHwKKQI4t2-m2o8BAVjKVf6lZj6lGi8gbUJMQQM9XX_SXs_hvMFaFuXhIV2ehIhXR21RkhWDLgKewzN5yFPDFXTLBTVmNDuNjPCcD_xdOHbtl1-SFUJwUWdQ553zkLicuyuE0nZk16f "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today. ")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won’t win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we’ll start pumping more oil and gas – and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We’ll stand with our allies – from Israel to Ukraine – and stand up to our enemies – in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won’t just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won’t be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=150ca4112ccd477591edb28936858a5d&_e=FVANl9ivly50zGnpCNNL5-M90a5uKq5biHbTxfnkq5UGjMWyJeTYxOyzlIn802tyFfEfaO-nlakZwXReYhbP7Vg3p9pn2gYgPZ73PNkCIf_XRsL0Kw_VPyUyMjg7VDniBXTNR3mCtLC4CJIpsYDJC_fUtfocgk6c8rJa6-X_hMVebKVmLJ7K6iCqZk_ZTXoDXEveW2ZZbKrBh-i38v9qOCk9EzHscbq7oKjpbHNHHAgsPt1gFc8fVZFeSS09jvgf5BW8Jrk10ce09DdelrK0m1ytUWC-QoyY8BAwsfio0cKkMGw5H2NFT9tiIXdxX3nUh_Inm-Puc3DZQ0fQRaJWomDifkyiWG54PRNRgk9qWUBDOw1OK_atxf1xytuMyOxy "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know – you can’t complain about what you get in a general election if you don’t play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I’ve done it before, and I’ll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=150ca4112ccd477591edb28936858a5d&_e=FVANl9ivly50zGnpCNNL5-M90a5uKq5biHbTxfnkq5UGjMWyJeTYxOyzlIn802tyFfEfaO-nlakZwXReYhbP7Vg3p9pn2gYgPZ73PNkCIf_XRsL0Kw_VPyUyMjg7VDniBXTNR3mCtLC4CJIpsYDJC_fUtfocgk6c8rJa6-X_hMVebKVmLJ7K6iCqZk_ZTXoDXEveW2ZZbKrBh-i38v9qOCk9EzHscbq7oKjpbHNHHAiI5iVuESFKGIUa52Czwr2sdy8JMa3urZkBy1cg5DC3NDlFTrMVAByuRFW7Cr07q6DtDhTL41Ig0HMn6MctwdCdtNOmED3qaHIrKXkyrRVEa6CxeDFKFNLujb1C36vh8TXsUlx9_7Gh4AmLkErHWMKb "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country. ")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

The GOP and conservative special interest groups have been playing a 50-year chess game to elect far-right extremists to every level of government to manipulate our country and attack our rights and freedoms. They are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for personal gain. But badass young people have a habit of being underestimated, from March For Our Lives to the Sunrise Movement to the Movement for Black Lives. And when we demonstrate our collective power, we scare the shit out of Republicans. That’s why with an incredible team, we launched Leaders We Deserve — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future. [We can’t do this without you by our side. name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9MTE80MjQwNSJ9/TK6PKJkDQEnmtUohWrYcMw)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 – trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come – a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 – there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment – vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9MTE80MjQwNSJ9/kFh7RNEdTKn_R1tv3IuQ5g)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource “The Major Characters of the End Times” as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: **[https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9V0VCJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249bXlzdGVyaWVzX2VuZF90aW1lcyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRV9MTE80MjQwNSJ9/-HvMxbvRO5_FRtGuUmFkNQ)**

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22820%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fojFwuIV04drreCm7AoKMA&sysid=1).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22821%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GmYPVq%2fv4EubS1NaAIBp5w&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22822%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LRuLrDN7mzd6K5MT5lgqaA&sysid=1) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It’s a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can’t just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION --to DO SOMETHING about it, while there’s still time to save our country. **

That is why I’m writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of “We the People”--before it’s too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22823%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iCoXaaybuZN6jl4OpDddzw&sysid=1)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

subject: what’s next
body:
If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready...

| |

| | |
---
| | |
Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhgti6ueaq2f5eicsa41hgtakltruq3d7ann0hhg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5g61pb2cjh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zufa89or5070nagvgtvvucdqgbejd6g4h62f8apg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5g61pb2cjh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zubtpmefco2m6075r1eooj37mhsovfqcr2hidgmo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5g61pb2cjh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zo982ji9f8h7vf7mea74ec1fuei981m2v9huaebo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5g61pb2cjh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**
|
_Thank you in advance._

My very best,

body:

---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Stop a CATASTROPHIC liquefied natural gas project in Papua New Guinea. Our planet and people can’t afford it! >> ****[Take action now, Friend.](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1954717?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** A similar project led by Exxon-Mobil has been associated with _**human rights abuses**_ and _**broken economic promises**_ in the country. The new project would threaten Papua New Guinea’s Gulf Province – where rising sea levels have already forced some communities to **move their homes MULTIPLE TIMES** in a country where _**40% are below the poverty line.**_ This project is good for NOTHING but stuffing fossil fuel executives’ wallets. But the U.S. might approve this **CLIMATE BOMB** , dooming communities in Papua New Guinea to _**increased pollution**_ and dooming the entire planet to _**bake even faster!**_ [**Tell the U.S. Export-Import Bank to REJECT the proposed liquefied natural gas project in Papua New Guinea before it’s too late. Add your name by 11:59pm TONIGHT!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1954718?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1954719?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
UN researchers have confirmed that to reach even a 50% chance of avoiding catastrophic global warming we need to **immediately end all liquefied natural gas investments** like this project in Papua New Guinea. Otherwise, we will continue to see raging wildfires, unprecedented storms, and homes swallowed by a rising sea.
This isn’t a big ask, Friend. In fact, the U.S. already made an international commitment NOT to support projects like this – but **it’s considering violating that commitment anyway!** Your message could be the difference. [**Please, Friend, help us reach our goal of 2,389 more signatures by midnight tonight and SAVE our planet from another fossil fuel disaster! Sign now!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1954720?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. name: Pro Life Update
subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbh8765lpq4j7h3niuieu7l90f57cearv60iura8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z53a1ek4h5r9pq14fh31nrfb454c9eo07dtjqni0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvaansvfr0fqr5e2rh0cl7qvaaepiim9nkl7v628_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs) [NO](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z15q5ch4ar3a54qml0pi2a08l1uj15i10ttiia5g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zir0rs7al29765763ng3acplnmm2jjnp6437g8l0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend,

If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future!

I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - **[and how we can achieve that vision, together.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8paul6c5uc0nia1c4inpuhs3f4b7mrujq8s275g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs "and how we can achieve that vision, together.")**

I see a strong America - _full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone._

I see a proud America - _confident in who we are, and what we stand for._

And I see America leading the world - _in freedom and peace._

**I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality.** _**[It would mean the world to know you're on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I'm hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9c8cfl0356h8uhhmt40sn7i797uhl9lutk45n6o_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today.")**_

The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. _And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century._

The America I see has the courage and confidence to **defend our values** and **defeat our enemies.**

In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever.

In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela.

We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia.

And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose...

Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history!

Realizing this vision won't be easy. **[It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq8r6m9p4u33nimp3q23btpjlblcm3a9isg44f5o_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us.")**

It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary.

We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class.

I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there.

**[Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlhs2sa6i510mfven91gl1nu4brd89eqrtor2d48_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i64p36chh2bs "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country.")**

My very best,

clean_body: If you watched the debate, you know we’re ready... | | | | | | | | Friend, If you watched the debate, you know we're ready...Ready to move past the stale ideas and faded names of the past...and we are more than ready for a new generation to lead us into the future! I'm writing to you today with a vision of that future - "and how we can achieve that vision, together." I see a strong America - full of opportunity, that lifts up everyone. I see a proud America - confident in who we are, and what we stand for. And I see America leading the world - in freedom and peace. I 'm running for President to make this vision a reality. "It would mean the world to know you’re on my side. If you have $1 or more to spare, I’m hoping you will pitch in a generous contribution to my campaign today." The America I see will win the fight for the 21st Century. And, we won 't win the fight for the 21st Century if we keep trusting politicians from the 20th Century. The America I see has the courage and confidence to defend our values and defeat our enemies. In this America, the Armed Forces of the United States will be stronger and more innovative and capable than ever. In this America, we'll start pumping more oil and gas - and stop buying dirty oil from Venezuela. We'll stand with our allies - from Israel to Ukraine - and stand up to our enemies - in Iran and Russia. And in the America I see, Communist China won't just lose... Like the Soviet Union before it, the tyranny of its system will land the Communist Chinese government on the ash-heap of history! Realizing this vision won't be easy. "It will take an unparalleled level of commitment from all of us." It requires faith and a willingness to move past the status quo. It will require each and every one of you to know - you can't complain about what you get in a general election if you don't play in this primary. We need someone who can shake up Washington and the political class. I've done it before, and I'll do it again. I need your help to get there. "Please consider chipping in a special donation of $20.24 or more to my campaign today to help us continue to build a surge of momentum and save our country." | Thank you in advance. name: ICYMI News
subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z0c5vspu9esbs1f7e6fut73k1glbs32mf4n2a3j0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i6co36c5h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zma205ku9nqhkebn73t8cd94l4i3i6tgs4eemih8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i6co36c5h2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgauo534fphhq0aa13pob0q5tl5g0fr4buerh9so_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i6co36c5h2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvg2d64sgkpatqr3a0clmuodqcac6ab4mg2fgueo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i6co36c5h2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbth2h8k1po0325t6b24ds203f97qdld0nebnq5g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i6co36c5h2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friend, My name is Pat Harrigan. You don’t know me, but I’m a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point and fought in frontline combat for 18 months in some of the worst conditions on the planet.
---
* During my time on the battlefield of Afghanistan, I received a bronze star for showing leadership and courage in the face of extreme threats.

* I overcame some of the most difficult challenges in my life during my deployment, all because I was shoulder to shoulder with a team of brave Patriotic warriors watching my back.\
k
* When I returned home, I used the team skills I acquired in the Green Berets and my passion for the Second Amendment to create a small business of my own selling firearms.

---
But I believe that my most important accomplishment is my family, I’m the dad of two beautiful girls and the husband of a loving wife.

body:
| | | [](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=88e1da3e72aa4e23b24a11210d15201e&_e=nA2zzI6SM0-QAotqdn3vh46TFFzaDO1i6jHN88K6OFqnsFGLmxmU1uH9HvsuQ30CDvE8WX4do45HiU9jran70BcB9CxPs-DkrWbeubsphap7G2KlqphH1xsVf5pb0JpwvMRI2TwoHQGna6aO7J_n7cSwNQ4nCE6FlIKwakXXfFs3nBSPJdodjrZk9v8TtSa-us3OEmxQ8ytAInd-aCTttB8_81dzjbOfkSWI0M1BKcWLsBgU84rIfAhuZf6QW5H0XdrqMitqrQ2HbMQsBhB7NLyqtpbTL09HB05dOHU1NDiqTjzpa8iokVQcwTMYuTv5dM5l0wb94wheJT18J1dxbw6Gk4vQl_UV5bTPxMHgGqEz8j8rTcAVlxfWVckce5Mv)
---
My friend, In a world where heroes wear badges, our police officers put their lives on the line every day to keep us safe. These brave men and women deserve our unwavering support and respect. Sadly, not everyone sees it that way. As radical liberals and certain media outlets glorify chaos, our officers are unjustly vilified. It's sickening to watch. My friend, I've stood alongside our courageous police officers, fiercely defending them against absurd attacks from the Left and the media.**But my opponent? Well, that's a different story.**
You see, Marcy talks a big game about the police, but her actions in Congress tell a different story. **In 2020, she hopped on the progressive squad's bandwagon, trying to scrap qualified immunity—a**** _reckless_****move that would handcuff our police and put our safety on the line.**
---
[](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=88e1da3e72aa4e23b24a11210d15201e&_e=nA2zzI6SM0-QAotqdn3vh46TFFzaDO1i6jHN88K6OFqnsFGLmxmU1uH9HvsuQ30CDvE8WX4do45HiU9jran70BcB9CxPs-DkrWbeubsphap7G2KlqphH1xsVf5pb0JpwvMRI2TwoHQGna6aO7J_n7cSwNQ4nCE6FlIKwakXXfFs3nBSPJdodjrZk9v8TtSa-us3OEmxQ8ytAInd-aCTttNeuAvB0Mke-_DRf_9AaHRHE-LcavQeAbpNeWB_QgPsFH0ZMMdRJxY3A5mnxSFEO1H0WX3xvXXn49zrKtDadiP-rmWwyNEpDeluTObSpdQ7QUz7CgkROm0jorCKu3wxegF9McdB3R1QE8kC-jFvCFwhOnyKGdt407BuoyKgzZrjB)
---
My friend, we need leaders who back the blue and protect our communities**—Marcy Kaptur isn’t going to cut it. ** In Congress, I’ll fight to invest in law enforcement and provide them with the necessary resources to perform their duties efficiently and effectively. For what it's worth, I come from a family that understands the dedication of our law enforcement. My dad, after serving in the Army military police, became an Ohio State Highway Patrol Officer in the 1960s. He dedicated his life to protecting our community, just like the heroes we salute today. **[If you stand for our police and want to join the fight to retire Marcy, grab your own Blue Lives Matter yard sign for your front lawn. Let's make our support visible and clear.](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=88e1da3e72aa4e23b24a11210d15201e&_e=nA2zzI6SM0-QAotqdn3vh46TFFzaDO1i6jHN88K6OFqnsFGLmxmU1uH9HvsuQ30CDvE8WX4do45HiU9jran70BcB9CxPs-DkrWbeubsphap7G2KlqphH1xsVf5pb0JpwvMRI2TwoHQGna6aO7J_n7cSwNQ4nCE6FlIKwakXXfFs3nBSPJdodjrZk9v8TtSa-us3OEmxQ8ytAInd-aCTttLXFS4a_n1Z-EO-d97isIe-9nL9hazEDTmInOkgCWZ4j911THeiKsydvwLvnTfBEsoRRqJI2Ylk_-O2V9EReSzLZ4JfKtuiXT7wHT95pCozcbfapKSu3Yr-oXYOnql5EW91HBWxQ6XIWKZhoZhfQvqcvMZgleQy9lcnr2HkeZmcc)**
---
[**Get Your Blue Lives Matter Yard Sign Here**](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=88e1da3e72aa4e23b24a11210d15201e&_e=nA2zzI6SM0-QAotqdn3vh46TFFzaDO1i6jHN88K6OFqnsFGLmxmU1uH9HvsuQ30CDvE8WX4do45HiU9jran70BcB9CxPs-DkrWbeubsphap7G2KlqphH1xsVf5pb0JpwvMRI2TwoHQGna6aO7J_n7cSwNQ4nCE6FlIKwakXXfFs3nBSPJdodjrZk9v8TtSa-us3OEmxQ8ytAInd-aCTttEyLHr4gcDO-1uvcG5Ts_BwJ6_amGOwGkh3aVz6TcM3fZphKtLIN81BFxzApa7BBieFnk-NKL4BJiP5ip1UlvjqfnAZ1_F64Vc_3uuVUaFzdL0VH6u1x19tStbB5KpdUlUOoHZQIblV5TQAX3Sw_iXi9TKeC4qrMYC2-N3chcDRZ)

We believe our nation's strength lies in every eligible citizen's right to vote.

Fostering inclusive democracy, every voice heard, every vote counts.

subject: I have a favor to ask, but first:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
I can't help but reflect on all we've accomplished — together.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68894360/424471248/-2027002553?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzI3OTI0MjQtMzU0Ny1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Bq7_yvnMubcCKH8pxNSh0eha10fbsyilv5xUYY4n97o=&emci=f3a6609c-cc45-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=c2792424-3547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=3595835)

Peter,

In a moment, I'm going to ask you to consider **[chipping in $10, or whatever you can, to help me reach the $25,000 end-of-month fundraising goal this campaign has set.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68894361/424471249/688272239?refcode=em23_230830_eom1_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230830_eom1_fndd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=c2792424-3547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&amounts=5,10,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzI3OTI0MjQtMzU0Ny1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Bq7_yvnMubcCKH8pxNSh0eha10fbsyilv5xUYY4n97o=)** **But first, let me tell you a bit about what we're fighting for and what we've achieved so far:**

When I look back at my time in Congress as your representative, I am overwhelmed with pride and can't help but reflect on all we've accomplished — _together_ — for our district and state.

From my beginnings in economic development to my service in the Washington State Capitol, and now as your representative in the U.S. House, it has been an honor to stand up for the people of our region. **I could not be more proud to dedicate my career to folks from every corner of our beautiful state.**

With you by my side every step of the way, we're shaping a brighter future and making real progress on Capitol Hill. Just this year, we've launched the Puget Sound Federal Leadership Task Force, a collaboration with Rep. Marilyn Strickland, to enhance our region's influence on critical federal issues.

We've: introduced the Mental Health Improvement Act to tackle the mental health crisis within our armed forces; proposed the Yes In My Backyard Act, a crucial step toward investing in affordable, safe housing for our communities; secured _crucial_ funding for our region to improve salmon populations and protect our natural resources...**and SO much more.**

But let me be clear: _Our work is far from over._ From fighting to protect and advance fundamental voting rights to working to enshrine a woman's right to reproductive freedom into federal law since the fall of _Roe v. Wade_ , it's evident that the road ahead won't be without its challenges. But as long as I can count on your support, I know we have what it takes to not only protect this seat — but also to create real change for folks all across Washington.

| | On August 25, I met with families of children who were the victims of sex trafficking in the Fairfax County Public Schools. I learned of the widespread nature of sex trafficking in FCPS, including every secondary and high school in the system. In 2012 FCPS admitted that there were 800 reported cases in FCPS that year. In 2021, the reported figure topped 1,000. There is a trafficking epidemic in FCPS, and FCPS is culpable for its utter failure to protect children. I will serve as counsel for the families in their dealings with the state and with the media. I will also help advise them on ongoing litigation against FCPS. I will work with State Senate Candidate and former Fairfax Police Detective (sex trafficking unit) Bill Woolf to draft and submit legislation on the state and federal level to combat sex trafficking, ensuring thorough investigations of sex trafficking in public schools in urban areas, including FCPS and LCPS; to provide stiffer penalties for those engaged in these heinous crimes; and to compel disgorgement of money from the criminal sex trade to be used to compensate the victims and families whose lives have been permanently harmed by these horrific crimes.

| | On August 26, I attended a seminar by state Senate Candidate and Detective Bill Woolf entitled, “How Do We Protect Our Children from Sex Trafficking in Virginia?” at Seton Gym inManassas, Virginia. Bill, along with Susan Young, mother of a child in FCPS who was trafficked, were among those who spoke and explained the widespread threats posed to children from gang and syndicate sex traffickers working within FCPS. Bill and I spoke with one another about steps to be taken to combat sex trafficking in our state and nation. We will work together to ensure that those who commit these crimes are not only arrested but given stiff penalties, and to ensure that those victimized receive the support and care they need.

clean_body: Friend, The campaign to Save Virginia and Save America continued this past week with a presentation before the Republican Women of Harrisonb | | Can't see this message? | | | | | | Save Virginia, Save America Weekly Roundup | | | | | | | Friend, The campaign to Save Virginia and Save America continued this past week with a presentation before the Republican Women of Harrisonburg and Rockingham Counties; an interview on Wilkow TV with Andrew Wilkow; a Meet and Greet in Williamsburg; the Robert Scott Bell Show; a meeting with parents of children trafficked in the Fairfax County Public Schools; a presentation before the Arlington Young Republicans in Arlington; and a Seminar on Protecting Children from Sex Trafficking in Manassas. | | | | | STRAW POLL | | | | | | | | | | On August 21, I had the privilege of presenting to the Republican Women of Harrisonburg and Rockingham Counties in Harrisonburg, Virginia. We enjoyed strong support from the patriotic women present and appreciate their willingness to post yard signs and join Team Emord. | | | | On August 22, Andrew Wilkow interviewed me concerning the two-tiered system of justice in America on Wilkow TV. | | | | | | | | | | | On August 23, Emord supporters Bob and Kathy Childers held a Meet and Greet for us at Sal’s by Victor in Williamsburg, Virginia. Some 30 patriots joined us in support of the campaign. Team Emord continues to grow statewide, and we are particularly grateful for our Williamsburg supporters. | | | | | I want to remind Team Emord's friends and volunteers to follow us on Facebook for daily updates and news. Share, Like, and Comment on posts to help spread awareness of our campaign to Save Virginia, Save America! | | | | | | | | | On August 24, I appeared, as I do weekly, on the Robert Scott Bell Show to discuss the pressinglegal and political issues of the day. | | | On August 25, I met with families of children who were the victims of sex trafficking in the Fairfax County Public Schools. I learned of the widespread nature of sex trafficking in FCPS, including every secondary and high school in the system. In 2012 FCPS admitted that there were 800 reported cases in FCPS that year. In 2021, the reported figure topped 1,000. There is a trafficking epidemic in FCPS, and FCPS is culpable for its utter failure to protect children. I will serve as counsel for the families in their dealings with the state and with the media. I will also help advise them on ongoing litigation against FCPS. I will work with State Senate Candidate and former Fairfax Police Detective (sex trafficking unit) Bill Woolf to draft and submit legislation on the state and federal level to combat sex trafficking, ensuring thorough investigations of sex trafficking in public schools in urban areas, including FCPS and LCPS; to provide stiffer penalties for those engaged in these heinous crimes; and to compel disgorgement of money from the criminal sex trade to be used to compensate the victims and families whose lives have been permanently harmed by these horrific crimes. | | | | | | | On August 26, I had the privilege of presenting to the Arlington Young Republicans in Arlington, Virginia. I appreciate the great support shown our campaign by members of the group, and I welcome campaigning with them to achieve our mutual goals of a free and prosperous Virginia and United States. | | | | | | | | On August 26, I attended a seminar by state Senate Candidate and Detective Bill Woolf entitled, “How Do We Protect Our Children from Sex Trafficking in Virginia?” at Seton Gym inManassas, Virginia. Bill, along with Susan Young, mother of a child in FCPS who was trafficked, were among those who spoke and explained the widespread threats posed to children from gang and syndicate sex traffickers working within FCPS. Bill and I spoke with one another about steps to be taken to combat sex trafficking in our state and nation. We will work together to ensure that those who commit these crimes are not only arrested but given stiff penalties, and to ensure that those victimized receive the support and care they need. | | | | | | | | See you on the campaign trail, Jonathan | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Sign Up for Updates | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Share on social | | | | This email was sent from .

Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 13 years of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**

_**The Mackenzie Minute**_

* * *
Fellow American,

I hope everyone is enjoying their summer with family and friends.

Since announcing our campaign for congress, exciting things have been happening and I have been out and about meeting voters and helping our local Republican candidates on the ballot in 2023. Here are just a few highlights:

• Sharing my 4 Principles For America on Fox News
• Supporting our police and first responders at National Night Out
• Going door-to-door for local candidates in the upcoming election
• Volunteering with the Slate Belt Republican Committee
• Talking to patriots at The Lehigh Valley Tea Party
• Attending the Monroe Westend Republican Club

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

**SUPPORTING OUR POLICE**
Like many of you, I spent August 1st at National Night Out events (in Slatington Borough and Upper Macungie) supporting and saying thank you to the brave first responders and officers that protect and serve us every day.
**GOING DOOR-TO-DOOR TO ELECT LOCAL REPUBLICANS**
I have been going door-to-door encouraging voters to support their local Republican candidates this coming November. Every vote and every election matters – and winning local seats is the foundation to winning Congress, Senate and President next year!

**VOLUNTEERING WITH THE SLATE BELT GOP**
I was happy to join other local volunteers at the Slate Belt Republican Committee booth and talk to voters about the importance of our upcoming elections to their local communities.

**SPEAKING WITH LOCAL PATRIOTS & REPUBLICAN LEADERS**
It is always a pleasure to speak with fellow patriots concerned about making sure we preserve the American values our country was founded upon, and I got to do just that at the Lehigh Valley Tea Party meeting held at the Fearless Fire Company in Allentown.

I was also able to discuss my 4 Principles For American Plan with the Monroe County West End Republican Club.

I’m working hard every day to win not only my campaign – but to help Republicans win across our communities. I hope I can count on your support! name: American Briefing
subject: Our country is facing a constitutional crisis
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z3rlhv2glfecb5sp9ilnsu4ocv7s3chdaec5ndg8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i66o72cdh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi2qh0cpj00vgjimcbp9h015gao0lc440sti4ki0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i66o72cdh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvg0jskkff38rlbu9vslsmq4ppe3rk6b8bp12juo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i66o72cdh2bs) [NO](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znmgft1lovbvcsldg0sbqocnsqdb135obot8mfho_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i66o72cdh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztovg30ivhhlcdcvaptavean0utad8k8slttgsmo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i66o72cdh2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This special event will be happening on Tuesday, September 19th at 6PM at Adelphia Restaurant in Deptford, New Jersey. Learn more and save your spot here. Riley Gaines is a former University of Kentucky swimmer who stepped into the spotlight last year when she first spoke out against men competing in women’s sports. Gaines became a 12-time NCAA All-American swimmer and a five-time SEC champion. But last year, the integrity of her sport — and female sports as a whole — was called into question when University of Pennsylvania swimmer Lia Thomas, who had competed on the school’s men’s team his freshman, sophomore and junior years, began shattering records in the women’s category. Riley can recall wondering why no one was standing up for her or for any women in the room when a man was awarded the 2022 NCAA Women's Swimming Championships. This moment became her call to action: she felt compelled to defend and protect America’s daughters against the woke left and their gender-denying ideology. Riley has actively pursued her mission by speaking at events and making media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women’s sports and uphold vital truths. I spoke to Riley in our Common Ground podcast. Listen to her story HERE. Everything that Riley Gaines stands for is common sense. Click here to learn more about the 6th Annual Chairwoman's Reception that Riley will be headlining as the keynote speaker. Let's come together on September 19th to make a statement, to inspire change, and to take the reins of America's future. We look forward to standing with you. Until next time, Bill & The Common Sense Action Team

name: Connor Boyack
subject: BREAKING - Public school punishes kid for Gadsden Flag patch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Libertas Institute
body:
a public school in Colorado kicked Jaiden out of class. His crime? He wore a Gadsden flag patch on his backpack.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z67ijkfp2gacu43vscf1q1250of05sum1kcl5lk0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs "Tuttle Twins")

Friend,

On Monday, a public school in Colorado kicked Jaiden out of class. His crime? He wore a Gadsden flag patch on his backpack.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9u0hio2r49hqjegj5ghnspm29n9n8kl178j2ok8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)
But the director at Vanguard School, where Jaiden attends, believes that this historical flag has "origins with slavery" and is "disruptive to the classroom environment." He told Jaiden's mother that the boy could not return to class unless the patch was removed.

Jaiden refused to remove the patch. Good for him! (In an emergency meeting yesterday, the school board voted to allow Jaiden to wear the patch. That was a quick victory!)

Jaiden is a special kid. He stands up for his beliefs. More importantly, he stands up for the truth. As his mom explained to me, he's been reading the Tuttle Twins books for years and learning about freedom. Then, it came time for him to do something about it.

**What if we could teach an entire generation to be like Jaiden?**

_We can._

I created the Tuttle Twins books to teach kids the values of liberty, American history, free markets, and limited government. And I want to reach more kids like Jaiden to teach these ideas that are under threat in many schools.

**My mission is to distribute 1 MILLION copies of the Tuttle Twins books to schools, libraries, and families this year. We need more Jaidens. I am urgently emailing you to ask for your help with this goal. Every $10 raised helps distribute a new book.**

[Can you donate $10, $20, or even $100 today and help distribute copies of the Tuttle Twins?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqjflfbh2moen5v6gk9are4k868rsqhmp0oebobo_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)
