[Donate $100 = 10 Books Distributed >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5eouhceclosq54utc42nespv0as1tlqg31ei2e8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

[Donate $200 = 20 Books Distributed >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6ugucqmkd5qc7ug562efqk2j8r4e243hn7bkkvg_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

[Donate $500 = 50 Books Distributed >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zot3vju5urfi4re9hikc42kubp9olqg8bhddvtg8_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

[Donate $1,000 = 100 Books Distributed >>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4sg8g5h12qtjhufou7hvki4essnuchbp7uesr18_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

I had the fortune of breaking Jaiden's story; he's an avid reader of my Tuttle Twins books, which teach kids what their rights are and why they should stand up for them -- just like Jaiden now is. So he and his mother reached out to ask for help highlighting what the school had done to him.

But one thing we can do now is inspire millions more kids to believe in the ideas of liberty.

While I can't control what schools teach, I can do the next best thing - bring the ideas of liberty to libraries, schools, and families.

[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zu2bbncrtnnb29782c7tcjarh0af3uq9j981nt48_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

Since I started the Tuttle Twins in 2011, we have distributed over 5 MILLION copies globally!

Freedom is popular with the younger generation. But it is our duty to bring them pro-liberty books and resources to conceptualize these ideas.

[Here is how we plan to distribute 1,000,000 new copies of the Tuttle Twins:](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z33lf4eot81fkklr3j4fore0g6u6v8o8751c4d4g_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

1. Homeschool children and parents actively teaching their kids about the ideas of freedom and U.S. history can receive copies for education at home.

2. The Libertas Institute plans to place copies in public schools and libraries to give kids an alternative to the dangerous ideas of socialism.

3. To do this, we must raise funds to print and distribute these books. **It costs roughly $10 to produce and ship each book.**

[Please help me raise $20,000 in the next 48 hours by clicking here to make a donation and distribute copies of the Tuttle Twins to thousands of kids across the country!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrouhgoneialqtfjpsblhkvro6dau8n8f1komoi0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

[Donate](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv327gghphphv47cik4lqd34v8ult7dtkg4n9vb0_rp22sh2s8i66p76c5i61ob4c9h2bs)

The best part about the Tuttle Twins? Kids actually enjoy reading them.

Parents often tell me about some of the great conversations they have with their kids after they read the books together. The Tuttle Twins series also encourages entrepreneurship and teaches critical thinking skills you won't find discussed in many classrooms.

**This is the most promising path to save our kids from indoctrination and the dangers of socialism. You and I can create a new generation of young freedom fighters to defend our rights.**

Thank you for your support!

Connor Boyack
President, Libertas Institute
Author, Tuttle Twins

name: Sen. Heidi Campbell
subject: Nevertheless, we'll persist
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Campbell for State Senate, Chip Forrester, treasurer
body:
https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/ [https://www.voteheidicampbell.com/]
Peter,
After five days of absolute inanity, the Tennessee state legislature gaveled out of a truly extraordinary session that was characterized mainly by chaos, ineptitude, and the pursuit of petty grievances. While the House was determined to push through a substantial package of bills that likely would have made Tennessee less safe relative to gun violence, the Senate denied legislators the opportunity to present ANY legislation beyond the four bills that senate leadership averred were requested by the Governor.
Thankfully, we did not pass any of the legislation that would worsen the situation (e.g. arming teachers or trying minors as adults). However, most of the legislation that we passed simply modified or added funding to policies that were already in place. We expedited the background check system, fortified a program to offer free gun locks to purchasers, and required reporting on human trafficking. One good thing to come out of the session is that we increased funding for mental health services (though the devil is always in the details as to how those funds are deployed).
Given the hundreds of collective hours that were spent by our team and by the courageous and vigilant Covenant families, and groups like Moms Demand Action, Awake, Rise and Shine Tennessee, Students Demand Action, the Equity Alliance, and so many others to write, file, lobby, and support legislation that would save lives, it is an absolute travesty that we wasted hundreds of thousands of taxpayer dollars and did absolutely nothing to make our districts safer.
Nevertheless, we will persist. The positive takeaway from this past week is that more and more Tennessee residents are becoming aware of the totalitarian nature of our state and are showing up and speaking up. My office has already drafted 17 common-sense gun bills for the upcoming session and we will be working with stakeholders and with our colleagues in the legislature to do everything we can to bring sane gun policy to Tennessee.
Please don’t hesitate to reach out to me if you have any questions or concerns, and wishing you and yours a Happy Labor Day weekend!
Best,
Heidi

Know how we know you’re one of VoteVets most committed supporters?
#
Derek,
Know how we know you’re one of VoteVets most committed supporters?
You’re reading this email. Over the years, a ton of people have joined us. But not everybody stays up to date with the work we’re doing.
You have, and just opening this email and reading to this point is a good sign that you have our back, even if we haven’t convinced you to donate yet.
And that’s good, because we need your help.
Tomorrow, we close the books on our August fundraising. And next month is an official FEC deadline month, which means we will be legally required to report our numbers. Everything we’ve raised will be public. A lot of people will be watching — our friends and our foes.
If we’re able to put in a strong report, we can support more of our friends. We can run ads around the country — ads that can swing races and win elections.
If we’re not, we have to scale back. And our foes in the GOP will notice... they’ll start making plans of their own, and that could lead to barrages of attack ads that can sink a campaign.
That’s why it’s really important that we put up a big number next month.
But right now, we’re still a bit short of our August goal. If you make your first donation today, we will get there.
[**Can you make your first donation of $3 before tomorrow’s deadline at midnight? Every donation helps, and with thousands of people joining you we will reach our goal.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-august23.WcYsFQ&refcode=em230830-1-30&t=1&akid=15727%2E3013755%2EAKQBXx)**

| |
---
| | Friend,

Election season is upon us! As our state and nation gear up for 2024, Janelle and I have been hitting the pavement, speaking with voters around the state to spread our message to all corners of Georgia. We have met some outstanding people and reconnected with past supporters of all backgrounds. If you haven't had the opportunity to "Catch the Kings," here's a summary of what we've been up to:
---
|
---
| Last week, we joined the Conservative Republican Women of North Atlanta for their Annual Salad Supper. We enjoyed discussing our mission of promoting conservative values and providing updates on our progress. We were also honored to be invited to the Georgia Teen Republicans' State Convention this year. Talking with these young conservatives filled us with hope and inspiration. Congratulations to all the new officers!
---
|
---
---
| We had a fantastic night in Henry County in July. During our discussion, we emphasized the importance of spreading conservative principles to strengthen the Republican Party. Thank you to Wendy Jones and the entire Henry County Republican Women for inviting us to share our message! And we had a great evening with the members of the Clarke County Republican Party, where we discussed what success looks like to us and how to engage diverse communities with a conservative message.
---
|
---
| We also had an exciting Saturday morning with the great people of the Republican Party of Jackson County. Janelle and I immensely enjoyed discussing how the state party can expand membership by sharing our conservative principles with others—special thanks to Jeff, Marty, and the entire Jackson County GOP for the invite.
---
|
---
| You may have recently noticed us on your TV screens or over your radio! We enjoyed filling in for Martha Zoller on WDUN in June. CBS News also featured Janelle recently, where she discussed the rise of conservatism in diverse communities. You can [check that out here](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=71a7e50e02&e=cb396c52a2)!

We're continuing to break the internet! We want to thank our brilliant, featured storytellers, [Arefeen Chowdhury](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=9fcf4de77b&e=cb396c52a2) and [Lucretia Hughes](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=8e530f86fb&e=cb396c52a2), for allowing us to showcase how conservative ideals and the American Dream have impacted their lives. Follow us on all social channels to catch these excellent interviews!

Facebook: [Let's Win for America Action](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=4e02c0f924&e=cb396c52a2)
Twitter: [@LWFAA_](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=979959471f&e=cb396c52a2)
Youtube: [Let's Win For America Action](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=4ca306c58e&e=cb396c52a2)
Instagram: [@lwfaa_](https://LWFAA.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e05b015cc2e6982fdaa22b89&id=9d0d30a351&e=cb396c52a2)

We're excited to see what the next few months hold for LWFAA! We'll continue to post reactions to presidential debates, keep you all updated on our minority outreach, and so much more. The support for our cause is growing exponentially, and we can't thank you enough. LWFAA is funded by activists like you who believe in creating tremendous growth in the GOP through engaging diverse communities and spreading the message of the American Dream to those who need to hear it the most. We ask that you continue to support us as the state and nation enter this critical election cycle.
God Bless,

Kelvin King
Chairman, Let’s Win for America Action

Would you like to have Kelvin or Janelle speak at an event? Contact [Info@LWFAA.com](mailto:Info@LWFAA.com) to connect with a scheduler and get your event on our calendar!

Friends,
On episode 3 of the State Freedom Caucus Network podcast, I spoke to State Senator Colton Moore, the Vice Chair of the Georgia Freedom Caucus.
Sen. Moore has received [national attention](https://substack.com/redirect/169aec62-29fd-4dac-b976-724778d13142?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over the last two weeks for pushing the Georgia legislature to launch a special session to investigate the actions of Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis and her political prosecution of President Donald Trump.
"We must strip all funding and, if appropriate, impeach Fani Willis," Sen. Moore said.
We discussed the path forward to hold Willis accountable for weaponizing her office against the leading political opponent of President Biden. Due to the importance of this topic, the episode is available to all of our subscribers, not just premium.
You should still become a paying subscriber to the SFCN on Substack to get future episodes of the podcast, as well as other exclusive content about what our Freedom Caucuses are doing all over America

Will you comply with another round of mask mandates?
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H2kPrflXKSSi8BdKLGg0nmovNPcjEU-IAGZ6UepoAVYZS_r8-c1qQadCwr0leXBpF3DSc2MuwT5-wjISr6iWwkVn-TN-m4ldNckVSRyI4rFhWTY2jjDtFvzcnEY6OHPsj1GJrNTQtM44S5va6mcyAA==&c=6NyKN6TI5_QlZ470qg5lGcaCsXADb3LE0Py668xkeClnat11SGY97A==&ch=hZsOQospC4MzD9oUNTW7wGp4Cp1lIG4HETs5FVddXIbETy7Fi1T2qQ==)
---
| Peter,
---
It's time to channel our inner Samuel Adams and stir the pot of U.S. liberty once again! Morris Brown College in Georgia and the LA County Department of Health are pulling a deja vu with mask mandates.

---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H2kPrflXKSSi8BdKLGg0nmovNPcjEU-IAGZ6UepoAVYZS_r8-c1qQbKWIMeYdgt8A7WAGOwAgDZp8pBAl2yTlDao5jYuu7d6jEMsBEvRN-wbtEq_tF4XFJhq8e0CtxxsfvLxiK_kwMD3FCw3AYMHVk3jGuQXADzskn6eJJ7AApyNUvPF25GQ13r10Q7eQFNf0TqiBiIaF-o=&c=6NyKN6TI5_QlZ470qg5lGcaCsXADb3LE0Py668xkeClnat11SGY97A==&ch=hZsOQospC4MzD9oUNTW7wGp4Cp1lIG4HETs5FVddXIbETy7Fi1T2qQ==)
---
Let's NOT replay history's greatest hits of calculated overreach and authoritarian compliance. We're not here to be mindless puppets of a Biden masked theater. We're here to remind the world that we're the land of the free and the home of the brave. We won't be tangled in mandates that are suspiciously timed and located to prime the pump FOR A RERUN of massive spending bills from DC that will 'combat another threat to the human race'. We've seen this bait and switch before. Never Again!
And that's because of truth warriors, such as Senators Ron Johnson and Rand Paul, who bravely challenged the powers that be, have demanded transparency, and refuse to take any nonsense. As your next Non-Compliance Freedom Senator from Nevada, I pledge to you that I will stand with them in this fight for truth, accountability, and liberty.
And speaking of truth, remember those who were cast aside for daring to question the narrative? The ones who got silenced, attacked, or worse, simply for wanting to know the facts? Well, guess what? The age of the silenced is over. The silent majority will be heard, and I will be that voice along with President Donald Trump..
I will NOT comply with another round of these nonsensical mandates. [It's time to put our foot down and say, "Enough is enough!"](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H2kPrflXKSSi8BdKLGg0nmovNPcjEU-IAGZ6UepoAVYZS_r8-c1qQbKWIMeYdgt8A7WAGOwAgDZp8pBAl2yTlDao5jYuu7d6jEMsBEvRN-wbtEq_tF4XFJhq8e0CtxxsfvLxiK_kwMD3FCw3AYMHVk3jGuQXADzskn6eJJ7AApyNUvPF25GQ13r10Q7eQFNf0TqiBiIaF-o=&c=6NyKN6TI5_QlZ470qg5lGcaCsXADb3LE0Py668xkeClnat11SGY97A==&ch=hZsOQospC4MzD9oUNTW7wGp4Cp1lIG4HETs5FVddXIbETy7Fi1T2qQ==)

Peter — Twenty-two years ago, when I was North Carolina’s Attorney General, I chose a strong, smart leader named Josh Stein to head up our Consumer Protection team. Josh went from there to the State Senate and then eventually to serve his own two terms as Attorney General. And every day of those 22 years, he’s fought alongside me to get results for our state. **Now, he’s running in the 2024 elections for a new job. And today, I’m excited to endorse Josh Stein to be the next Governor of North Carolina. Term limits prevent me from running again, but I know Josh is the right choice to double down on the progress we’ve made.** Peter, I know firsthand how tough his race is going to be. Right now, Josh is tied in the polls against an extremist opponent who’s too dangerous for our state — so he needs your help. **[I need you to join me and support Josh’s campaign by making a contribution to Team Stein today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68908824/424522808/204239717?refcode=ea.f458f1e4-4547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.f458f1e4-4547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNDU4ZjFlNC00NTQ3LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SJ6A_bTVAJb1Qfn1XaNBXqxgKhooO8RICCe5BOs7VI8=)** _100% of your donation will support Josh Stein for Governor._ | [DONATE »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68908827/424522824/204239717?refcode=ea.f458f1e4-4547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.f458f1e4-4547-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNDU4ZjFlNC00NTQ3LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SJ6A_bTVAJb1Qfn1XaNBXqxgKhooO8RICCe5BOs7VI8=)

**Josh leads with integrity and grit and is committed to fighting for the people.**
He’s taking on Big Pharma to get illegal opioids and fentanyl off our streets. He’s stopping scammers and predatory lenders from bankrupting everyday people. He teams up with law enforcement and prosecutors to keep our communities safe and make our justice system work better for everyone.
I know Josh Stein. He’s driven by a steadfast commitment to our great state. That’s why he’ll work every day to invest in students and public schools, put health care within reach for hardworking folks, and grow jobs that pay better and make life more affordable for the middle class.
**With a record of results and a clear-eyed vision for our future, Josh is ready to do this job.**

clean_body: He’s ready to do the job. | Peter — Twenty-two years ago, when I was North Carolina’s Attorney General, I chose a strong, smart leader named Josh Stein to head up our Consumer Protection team. Josh went from there to the State Senate and then eventually to serve his own two terms as Attorney General. And every day of those 22 years, he’s fought alongside me to get results for our state. Now, he’s running in the 2024 elections for a new job. And today, I’m excited to endorse Josh Stein to be the next Governor of North Carolina. Term limits prevent me from running again, but I know Josh is the right choice to double down on the progress we’ve made. Peter, I know firsthand how tough his race is going to be. Right now, Josh is tied in the polls against an extremist opponent who’s too dangerous for our state — so he needs your help. = 100% of your donation will support Josh Stein for Governor. | = Josh leads with integrity and grit and is committed to fighting for the people. He’s taking on Big Pharma to get illegal opioids and fentanyl off our streets. He’s stopping scammers and predatory lenders from bankrupting everyday people. He teams up with law enforcement and prosecutors to keep our communities safe and make our justice system work better for everyone. I know Josh Stein. He’s driven by a steadfast commitment to our great state. That’s why he’ll work every day to invest in students and public schools, put health care within reach for hardworking folks, and grow jobs that pay better and make life more affordable for the middle class. With a record of results and a clear-eyed vision for our future, Josh is ready to do this job. = 100% of your donation will support Josh Stein for Governor. Friend,

If you didn't get to watch the debate, I want to make sure you know my story.

I've been underestimated in every race I've run. But I've never lost a race, and I'm not starting now. **[That's why I'm asking you to chip in today and help me win this fight.](http://links.right-gop.com/u/click?_t=2ba4f933732b46f5b6eae32741d1832c&_m=1b100d7402bf4cb694beea7c28a8a41e&_e=4hB-KerEj9DqEIWmd1-Bakc1q5RnYMoxo0d-XMPPYJmwrRXIQGOyrGRwhR-nQFgvPEuuGMftTM6UKIuSHjG9JghcF7WgWUkK-lbtwtNRmvkw9yZJs50Uv3L-ZkaeJi43D3LkOVPQ1HZMz5fMurCyB5Ebq8n7I0aJ_ys3DsbH58ZprsJ9HBGA1_237zwKHvJKDJ3vYr-EpbnwDIgTaFFLERog5XnruYjcm1F_k7IE0xA9MggrIlFcEnJtpZqzc77-4SE_llsqteBZnD1BapYvlOfXopOghhtQauk9NOFLAAis2UEW8PrbSLytgr6OxR4LSwLk0S7TbHKKFjEMU4nt2PaPQ7FDShpOYK-nORur2RFaUOF_m2sr7FbzWZVAZGmC9GHptlK9TBvz5gOajMMfLYugc4Ro59StR6i19Kg5hVIqgegB_qefCqZHTCSDM5ULjHCebj80e6fR0tQeiOzQ9KmFNnpqyPzh9BF25lT8O1sblAoofqhH8VDjLrvW_AVH6NisjrKyUhoNCqJ_Ko1OnO8-0mP3JWtlqsQcjFsCQABLGCxzYw4w6cAyjle4N4lo14h0Xy763_1fqNVcVuFFqHDvO9kVv4dkiNfKKfZxhY4%3D "That’s why I’m asking you to chip in today and help me win this fight. ")**

When I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state, no one said I had a shot. A week before the primary, I was polling at 15 percent.

_**But together, we won.**_

When I ran for governor, people asked, "Nikki who?" I was polling in fourth place with just a few months until Election Day. I was the least funded, and least known GOP candidate in the race.

_**But together, we won.**_

Then we cut taxes, created thousands of jobs, and revitalized our economy. Business journals started calling South Carolina the Beast of the Southeast - which I loved!

When I was nominated for Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. _Then I went to work._ I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: I’m running to defeat Rick Scott
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Friends,
My name is Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. I’m an immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. And I’m officially running to defeat Sen. Rick Scott and serve as Florida’s next U.S. Senator.
Rick Scott has failed us in Florida, and I refuse to sit back and watch him push my state and country backward. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our economy, and our very democracy — and even more, I’m prepared to win.
But this race will be one of the most competitive Senate races in 2024, and we’re up against a deep-seated Republican incumbent who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time around. The only way I can compete — and win — is with the support of grassroots Democrats like you.
I've set an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by midnight to defeat Rick Scott, and I need your help to reach it. Please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Serve America right now to flip Florida blue and expand our Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
When I was 14, my mom, my three sisters, and I left our home in Ecuador to find a better life in America. We lived in a one room apartment. My mom worked double-shifts during the day and took classes at night to learn English. I picked up shifts at the local doughnut shop to help make ends meet.
Those years weren’t easy. But thanks to my mother’s relentless belief in a brighter future for her children, I went on to graduate from college, become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and write the bill to expand Medicare Advantage coverage.
My story — coming from a one room apartment to walking the halls of Congress — is only possible in America. But Rick Scott has spent his time in Washington doing everything he can to destroy the country that gave my family a shot at a better life.
Rick Scott has a net worth up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars, yet he’s proposed tax increases on working families and the middle class. He’s pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. And he wrote the GOP plan to end the Social Security and Medicare that so many rely on.
That’s why I’m running to defeat him next November. Experts say that Rick will be one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot — which means that if we build a powerful grassroots team full of people like you, friend, we can take him down.
So please, I’m personally asking: Will you become one of my very first grassroots donors by splitting a gift between my campaign and Serve America today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to defeating Rick Scott and defending our Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-dmp]
Thank you for joining me in this fight for a better Florida and a better future for all of us.
With gratitude,
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 30
GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES EARLY PROGRESS IN EFFORT TO SUPPORT ACCURATE VOTER ROLLS
ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia announced its first round of corrections to Georgia's statewide voter rolls. As part of the [Election Integrity Defenders Initiative](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019FGKuTZv1-ME3vvBQkLed_KA4Fwz-r4MXVxnl6dGFtJCqGKN8k7pOFErBUFzRF7eOvEPUik5_EOd4lshg5my_svMz5EpB-Ufk1Dt-ZK1Kmis1IzSlcHbn6YTIFh078dUFq8AtU0Xe6tBbP5PxX6rQA1vY1G3Xok0SkXUopLHjsY=&c=Q5HsoMZ-yay5pby7lXohnYJjBsk2wO3fJxO-_pOayUskylVMfoczBA==&ch=cEt3PJiKDHCmr9JIW7Q6XQlKu3uOWYlZPOv4gXuWmHjIlKUSWJqOIw==), the group identified more than 7,000 voters whose registrations contained clerical errors - and partnered with local volunteers to submit the registrations for curing with county boards of election.
The 7,000 voters submitted by Greater Georgia were not included in the list of 191,000 voters who are [scheduled to be removed](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019FGKuTZv1-ME3vvBQkLed_KA4Fwz-r4MXVxnl6dGFtJCqGKN8k7pOFErBUFzRF7e6LH7BCVpIL7GiKIges2Od_er4gfcokvc3WkYUp_j11Q9TTc400FVtrE9OOSh_3r14U6zWZPCf1VZLU0bogTbX-ktmfAmFOM-pwBSrexb9Cc90Rl0S_MeDumWO-pFFUPPEb6_lS_9DnZGudM8OWCQipAvTGnz9t2OGlCPRSRZLAshuFREasDtCTU1QvD9foOpSqvGY7EJW06hULjwO-WyIhc8xENqN3pd&c=Q5HsoMZ-yay5pby7lXohnYJjBsk2wO3fJxO-_pOayUskylVMfoczBA==&ch=cEt3PJiKDHCmr9JIW7Q6XQlKu3uOWYlZPOv4gXuWmHjIlKUSWJqOIw==) from the rolls by the Georgia Secretary of State and may not be subject to Section 229 or 230 challenges due to the clerical nature of their inaccuracies. The registrations primarily contain missing or incomplete voter information. Once corrected, the identified voters will be able to cast their ballots without issue. "Voter roll maintenance is one of the many important aspects of supporting fair and secure elections in Georgia, and the ability to conduct that process is part of state law," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Maintaining accurate voter rolls is about protecting the rights of legal voters in having their voice heard in our elections. Just as our ongoing statewide voter registration work does already, this program transcends partisan politics to help ensure voter registration data is current, accurate, and complete so that every legal vote counts."
Over the coming months, Greater Georgia will continue to review the state's voter rolls to identify voters who may be ineligible - including those who are registered at a business address, who have moved out of state, or who are deceased. By finding and challenging ineligible voters early, well ahead of the state's scheduled elections, Greater Georgia will help ensure accurate voter rolls by the time Election Day arrives.
The Election Integrity Defenders Initiative is accepting volunteers and will run through 2024. For more information and to volunteer, click[ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019FGKuTZv1-ME3vvBQkLed_KA4Fwz-r4MXVxnl6dGFtJCqGKN8k7pOFErBUFzRF7eOvEPUik5_EOd4lshg5my_svMz5EpB-Ufk1Dt-ZK1Kmis1IzSlcHbn6YTIFh078dUFq8AtU0Xe6tBbP5PxX6rQA1vY1G3Xok0SkXUopLHjsY=&c=Q5HsoMZ-yay5pby7lXohnYJjBsk2wO3fJxO-_pOayUskylVMfoczBA==&ch=cEt3PJiKDHCmr9JIW7Q6XQlKu3uOWYlZPOv4gXuWmHjIlKUSWJqOIw==)[HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019FGKuTZv1-ME3vvBQkLed_KA4Fwz-r4MXVxnl6dGFtJCqGKN8k7pOFErBUFzRF7eOvEPUik5_EOd4lshg5my_svMz5EpB-Ufk1Dt-ZK1Kmis1IzSlcHbn6YTIFh078dUFq8AtU0Xe6tBbP5PxX6rQA1vY1G3Xok0SkXUopLHjsY=&c=Q5HsoMZ-yay5pby7lXohnYJjBsk2wO3fJxO-_pOayUskylVMfoczBA==&ch=cEt3PJiKDHCmr9JIW7Q6XQlKu3uOWYlZPOv4gXuWmHjIlKUSWJqOIw==).

name: Team Kennedy
subject: RFK, Jr. Asks Us To Participate in a National Day of Service!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY
body:
“Ask not what your country can do for you. Ask what you can do for your country.” On September 11th this year, Mr. Kennedy is asking all of us the same question.

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=1)
---
Peter -- Are you signed up to participate in a service project for the [National Day of Service](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=2)? Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. has asked all of us to participate in the September 11th National Days of Service and Remembrance, on September 9, 10, and 11. Mr. Kennedy wants us to harness the enthusiasm and momentum of his campaign to spark positive, lasting change for communities that need it most, NOW, rather than waiting for some distant time in the future. Mr. Kennedy will be right by our side, participating in service projects as well. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=3) Over the past three weeks, volunteers across the country have answered this call to service by submitting over 100 Day of Service projects! These hosts are looking to others in their communities to join their project and contribute a few hours of time. Will you sign up for a service project? | [](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=4 "Sign Up To Volunteer") [Sign Up To Volunteer](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-day-of-service?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=4)
---
Some projects are filling up fast, while others still have a need for many volunteers. With over 100 projects available to choose from–with one in almost every state–we hope you can [find one near you](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-events?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=5). If not, there are also several virtual projects (see below), as an alternative, or submit your own project! These service projects are a great way to meet other supporters in your region!
**To Find a Service Project Near You:**
1. Go to the [Day of Service Events Page ](https://www.kennedy24.com/september-11-events?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=6)
2. Enter your zip code and select the distance you would be willing to travel to participate.
3. Explore the date, time, and activity for the projects closest to you and choose the best one for you.
4. Click the RSVP button and fill out the form so that the host can contact you with up to date information.
5. Invite your friends and family, and share the link in your confirmation email with your networks by text, email, and social media.

If you have any questions, email us at [dayofservice@teamkennedy.com](mailto:dayofservice@teamkennedy.com).
Let’s show the world that **we the people** are ready, willing, and able to heal our country!
Warm Regards,
Team Kennedy
[Dayofservice@teamkennedy.com](mailto:Dayofservice@teamkennedy.com)
PS. [“Day of Service” t-shirts](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=92YYov9O17-vE3x_2FgMqcpC3Uu0TtfyErPHzkeABYjoC-VXKOry0umcl-b5ZjM4E8op1cOp14wjZfxVsUUuwQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=7) are available for order, and you may choose to wear yours with other volunteers during the event.
Can't attend in person? Check out one of the virtual projects:
1. Holiday Cards for Our Military \- [here](https://www.kennedy24.com/unusualamerican/holiday_cards_for_our_military?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=8)
2. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/earthbody/holding_space_for_my_community_with_a_free_virtual_earth-body_reclamation_circle?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=9)Activities throughout central Texas to protect water resources and to feed people in need - [here](https://www.kennedy24.com/texaslinda/activities_throughout_central_texas_to_protect_water_resources_and_to_feed_people_in_need?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=10)
3. Spread Love through "Open Heart Origami" - [here](https://www.kennedy24.com/olifeclass/spread_love_through_open_heart_origami_with_oho_lab?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=11)
4. Virtual Reclamation Circle \- [here](https://www.kennedy24.com/earthbody/holding_space_for_my_community_with_a_free_virtual_earth-body_reclamation_circle?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=12)

[Donate today](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=13) to put a Kennedy back in the White House — Elect Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. as President to unite America in 2024! Make sure to join us on Social Media to help spread our campaign's message and put Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. in the White House! [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nQ2OSzJvbzn8H14UVJyZeU&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=14) [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvJMDEmDChn4crVEdym-uYEvPdkFBV9SaYXx39MwIdLI&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=15) [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6hyvAYXBs1PELL28GD73y2F3NBqF5BJJJ4dLoTp9j7umB4CtvDL9QcHxwZkP_0TO&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day_of_service_non_donors_1&n=16)
* * *
PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY
This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com).

The climate crisis isn’t a distant threat.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68912861/424536230/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGRiMTUxMy00ZDQ3LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=enedJJyJDhsMEiYYFu1HjYP5JZcplGGC7xfUXNcZslc=&emci=80d358d0-7d43-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=4ddb1513-4d47-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9818364)

| | I just spent the last month traveling around Oregon. In every county I visited, I heard from residents, small business owners, state and local officials, and more about how extreme weather, droughts, and wildfires are hitting our communities hard. **The climate crisis isn't some distant threat. It's here, and folks across our state are already dealing with the consequences.** Last year, Democrats passed the largest investment in clean energy in our nation's history. The Inflation Reduction Act is a huge victory in the fight to act on climate, and I'm proud of the role I played to get it across the finish line. But there's always more work to do. Continuing investment in clean energy solutions, lowering carbon emissions, and holding Big Oil accountable for its role in the climate emergency remain at the top of my priority list. **The battle against the climate crisis is the fight of our generation. We've seen what we can get done with a razor-thin Democratic majority in the Senate, but we need to do more.** **[The only way to build on our progress is to protect and expand our Democratic majority. Will you join the movement for a cleaner, healthier planet and donate $3 today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68912865/424536239/-2044921950?refcode=2023-08-30-eom-climate&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=4ddb1513-4d47-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGRiMTUxMy00ZDQ3LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=enedJJyJDhsMEiYYFu1HjYP5JZcplGGC7xfUXNcZslc=)** Despite the overwhelming evidence of the consequences of the climate emergency, the GOP continues to be driven by campaign donations from Big Oil and wealthy executives. I'm tired of their excuses, and I know you are, too. The truth is that MAGA Republicans have cozied up to powerful fossil fuel companies. Greed – not science – is what drives their climate agenda. **We can't afford to wait for MAGA Republicans to pull their heads out of the sand.** **[For the sake of our climate and future generations, we must protect and expand our Senate majority. clean_body: The climate crisis isn’t a distant threat. | | | | I just spent the last month traveling around Oregon. In every county I visited, I heard from residents, small business owners, state and local officials, and more about how extreme weather, droughts, and wildfires are hitting our communities hard. The climate crisis isn't some distant threat. It's here, and folks across our state are already dealing with the consequences. Last year, Democrats passed the largest investment in clean energy in our nation's history. The Inflation Reduction Act is a huge victory in the fight to act on climate, and I'm proud of the role I played to get it across the finish line. But there's always more work to do. Continuing investment in clean energy solutions, lowering carbon emissions, and holding Big Oil accountable for its role in the climate emergency remain at the top of my priority list. The battle against the climate crisis is the fight of our generation. We've seen what we can get done with a razor-thin Democratic majority in the Senate, but we need to do more. = Despite the overwhelming evidence of the consequences of the climate emergency, the GOP continues to be driven by campaign donations from Big Oil and wealthy executives. I'm tired of their excuses, and I know you are, too. The truth is that MAGA Republicans have cozied up to powerful fossil fuel companies. Greed – not science – is what drives their climate agenda. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | There is little to be said about the tragedy that happened in Jacksonville this weekend that has not already been said. We mourn Angela Michelle Carr, Anolt Joseph “AJ” Laguerre Jr., and Jerrald Gallion, and we pray for their loved ones and all those involved in these stunning acts of unadulterated hatred.

**The Collective PAC unequivocally condemns the evil that occurred in Jacksonville this weekend.
**
This was yet another example of racism and white supremacy and a reminder that both are alive and well in our nation.

We have been fighting hate organizations like the KKK for more than a hundred years, and as we all know, that fight is hardly over.

If we want to emerge stronger and more united, we must re-dedicate ourselves to ensuring that our nation’s diversity is reflected in its leaders.

We must continue to work tirelessly to replace the extreme right-wing contingents that have permeated our governments with more people of color up and down the ballot.

We must continue to educate and advocate on the issues facing our communities.

We must keep fighting no matter what — because together, we can overcome.

Thank you for standing with us, and for supporting a better and more equal future that is within our reach.

The Collective PAC
* * *

[](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953w5O3Wwmdygae0W-34efSvb_hfX51xtIkq_nCgr0tl8iRqUTOndcJRC4vm20WcsKLgjmXxr_GWG_dQvtD_6OVsxYC8l9N0pY3_503UsZQ8TwFzmCMU5UoghNFbqBJBbrBv9vTlH1nkqwu44fex5v5Hhe-pTjpH2SpxyJNtA8ePoXYBukPpibmsedx_2X9IJ1i43pkl9vSsTtyDPeGcDeO3ouS3QttJviw8X7HdlOEnTh-etsA_JDlzrbBN5GdVz5MYCTn_OeLVPtHQx-tByo1QmNyY16xDdQ66yE34Ph2G7M2zNlJdAOQ8RLtePbEDolriF8fQKMsd3R4-l3JoGUPdBCa9BHzI5btEyYh7xpLHvswEQ575n1XQXmBFEK61mpnA/3z6/5X0haxtTQAi6FnpigaQ0Cw/h1/98yKGkfbPkCp2T0eOWLccHeWUezT7JSNVjQA_O3oQJ0) | The Collective PAC is strategically focused on creating a truly equitable democracy where our nation’s local, state and federal governments have diverse and talented elected leadership and Black people are fully represented in positions of power to create the policies necessary to progress our communities forward. Since our inception in 2016, we have helped 110 candidates win general elections at the local, state and federal levels. If you'd like to unsubscribe | | There is little to be said about the tragedy that happened in Jacksonville this weekend that has not already been said. We mourn Angela Michelle Carr, Anolt Joseph “AJ” Laguerre Jr., and Jerrald Gallion, and we pray for their loved ones and all those involved in these stunning acts of unadulterated hatred. The Collective PAC unequivocally condemns the evil that occurred in Jacksonville this weekend. This was yet another example of racism and white supremacy and a reminder that both are alive and well in our nation. We have been fighting hate organizations like the KKK for more than a hundred years, and as we all know, that fight is hardly over. If we want to emerge stronger and more united, we must re-dedicate ourselves to ensuring that our nation’s diversity is reflected in its leaders. We must continue to work tirelessly to replace the extreme right-wing contingents that have permeated our governments with more people of color up and down the ballot. We must continue to educate and advocate on the issues facing our communities. We must keep fighting no matter what — because together, we can overcome. Thank you for standing with us, and for supporting a better and more equal future that is within our reach. subject: They can’t beat me

body:
I'll be honest, Peter—

Fundraising is one of the worst parts of this job, but just a few moments from now I’ll have to ask you to make a donation.

Give me a chance to explain: I’m not asking this often because I like it. I do it because national Republicans and out-of-state super PACs are pledging to spend outrageous amounts of money to attack my character and the only chance we have to respond is by collecting grassroots donations from a whole lot of people.

Peter, my opponents will try to turn me into someone I'm not, because they can’t beat who I am.

I’m a third-generation farmer, the Senate’s only working dirt farmer, and I’ll never stop fighting for the hardworking people that call Montana home.

Since we officially launched my reelection campaign, tens of thousands of people all over the country have chipped in to support us. That’s something I’m proud of, and it means that I’ll have a fighting chance to stand up to the millions of dollars the GOP will spend against me.

But we can’t slow down, not even for a minute, because experts are already saying that this will be the most expensive election in Montana’s history.

So with all eyes on our race, I have to ask, can I count on you to make a split donation between my campaign and David Trone right now to help us reach our end-of-month goal tomorrow? This is important. I need your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_fr_split_tester?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.08.30_B1_Tester_30op]

clean_body: I'll be honest, Peter— Fundraising is one of the worst parts of this job, but just a few moments from now I’ll have to ask you to make a donation. Give me a chance to explain: I’m not asking this often because I like it. I do it because national Republicans and out-of-state super PACs are pledging to spend outrageous amounts of money to attack my character and the only chance we have to respond is by collecting grassroots donations from a whole lot of people. Peter, my opponents will try to turn me into someone I'm not, because they can’t beat who I am. I’m a third-generation farmer, the Senate’s only working dirt farmer, and I’ll never stop fighting for the hardworking people that call Montana home. Since we officially launched my reelection campaign, tens of thousands of people all over the country have chipped in to support us. That’s something I’m proud of, and it means that I’ll have a fighting chance to stand up to the millions of dollars the GOP will spend against me. But we can’t slow down, not even for a minute, because experts are already saying that this will be the most expensive election in Montana’s history. So with all eyes on our race, I have to ask, can I count on you to make a split donation between my campaign and David Trone right now to help us reach our end-of-month goal tomorrow? Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

Dear Friend,

As Summer winds down and we turn to the Fall, I look forward to my travel to London where I will be speaking to 300 parliamentarians from around the world about the urgent need for energy security. The Ukraine War and Europe's recent reliance on Russian gas illuminate how important American energy independence really is. I continue to stress to our European allies and leaders from the Third World that every country urgently needs to secure a supply of cheap and reliable energy for its citizens.

My new 501c4, Fix Pennsylvania, is quickly moving forward using the same blueprint that Governors Rick Scott and Ron DeSantis used to turn Florida from a swing state to a red state.

No matter where you stand politically, it’s devastating to see a former U.S. president’s mugshot and the worst-ever political witch hunt in the history of our great country. And how ironic that the congress has revealed the Biden family’s corruption including bank records and whistleblower testimony and no news outlet or prosecutor seems especially interested. This is the most serious presidential scandal in the history of our country. I believe that Americans from both sides of the aisle want equal justice under the law.

It’s exciting to lead the charge for AFPI ‘s PA chapter as AFPI forms state chapters throughout the country. Below you can see AFPI’s warm welcome to former congressman Lee Zeldin who will be heading up our transition team. You can catch my most recent media hits, Trump Rally speech, and op-ed below.

We can all agree that our border needs to be secure and our government spending is out of control. This is why I am supporting President Trump’s reelection. If you would like to attend an event and/or support his campaign, I have included links below.

Sincerely,

Carla Sands
US Ambassador to the Kingdom of Denmark (ret.)
Vice Chair, Center for Energy & Environment, America First Policy Institute

** Welcome Congressman Lee Zeldin to the AFPI Family!
------------------------------------------------------------
This week, we announced former Congressman Lee Zeldin (NY-01) as the Chair of AFPI’s Pathway to 2025 Initiative. Congressman Zeldin’s wealth of experience and deep commitment to promoting the prosperity of our great Nation works seamlessly with our continued push to get America back on track.

The Pathway to 2025 Initiative encompasses five pillars to save America and her founding principles. The pillars highlight policy innovation, America First messaging opportunities, coalition building, and the preparation of a battle plan for the next conservative administration. This extraordinary project has the potential to steer America back to its roots so that by America’s 250th birthday in 2026, Americans will have a better and brighter future ahead.

"The America First Policy Institute is at the very tip of the spear, leading the charge to save our country. It is an amazing honor to chair AFPI’s bold and vital Pathway to 2025 Initiative. I’m excited about the immense impact this effort will make on the November 2024 election, and the resulting opportunity to ensure the strongest policies and personnel are in place on Day One, in January 2025. There is no nation in the history of the world that is more exceptional than our great nation, and to secure our republic, grow our economy, protect our constitution, and defend our freedoms and liberty, we must ensure our greatest talents and focus are totally committed to putting America First."
– Lee Zeldin, Former New York Congressman and Chair of AFPI’s Pathway to 2025

** Join Us for an Insightful Webinar on the Tragic Afghanistan Withdrawal
------------------------------------------------------------
On August 7, 2023, nearly two years after the Biden Administration began its chaotic withdrawal from Afghanistan, Congress held a public forum featuring the Gold Star families of all 13 Marines killed during the early days of the withdrawal. Two years later, we have an opportunity to learn more about what really happened—what they were told and saw, the importance of their testimonies, and what steps can be taken to hold the Biden Administration accountable. The America First Policy Institute is proud to convene a discussion moderated by Fred Fleitz, Vice Chair of the Center for American Security, and featuring Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Keith Kellogg, Co-Chair of the Center, and Robert Wilkie, Distinguished Fellow in the Center.

On Tuesday, August 22 at 11 a.m. ET, join our American security experts for a discussion (https://email.contact.americafirstpolicy.com/c/eJxskcGunSAQhp8Gd5zAoB5duOitsU2TNumuXZm5gEKDaGBOjG_feK-3i-Zsvxn-8P2Dyxb8dHTs_sIAnDeZATD1iQEc-gV_PYz78ZvvIvGU5v7bOYTPDICOzf7bvEJudkEfTnrvC9O9WiOaqbCdrFtQLZRtVbiTVlUtoZWV0Y0UUiioDciyVLpscSp8BwKUaGQDUkhV3WSLdVXJpgHT3M29YqXQayTUdMPFJq9x8inTtgavj5telyJ0jmjLb58bGAzP1xgMAclmYjCQsxyn2WH0mTDy3ZMzCXcMfHdIPFkM4eAOt81Ga5gaHrSMizX-sTDVX-L1CfP6SNoy1UcdxquZa6Rx2dDPkan-3ZB_qI7R7jlYIpvGSw6n7ePZGslGeo_kX_Hn9-l1pj_EoB5j8Iap_j_4dkfVp2PW9RdhitTpjNFkVornXfwNAAD__7ipqcQ) on the disastrous withdrawal from Afghanistan and its implications for foreign relations in the future. Our experts will delve into the complexities of this event, examining the short-term and long-term consequences of this withdrawal on global dynamics and the possible ramifications it has on the United States and its allies. The withdrawal has been met with significant criticism and has highlighted the
vulnerability of the Afghan government, leaving many questions unanswered. During the discussion, our experts will provide insights into the decision-making process that led to this outcome, shedding light on the factors that contributed to the perceived lack of planning and coordination. The sudden power vacuum created by the withdrawal may pave the way for the resurgence of extremist groups, potentially jeopardizing the progress made in the region over the past two decades. They will explore the potential impact on regional stability and how this event may shape future US foreign policy decisions.

** OP-ED: Linda McMahon: Protect small businesses from crime if you want a thriving economy
------------------------------------------------------------
Recently, Linda McMahon, AFPI Chair of the Board and Chair of the Center for the American Worker, penned an op-ed in Fox News on the rise of crime nationwide and its effect on small business, a bedrock of our economy.

The escalating surge in retail theft is wreaking havoc on businesses of all sizes nationwide. A recent survey conducted among retail and grocery workers revealed that a staggering 50% of them bore witness to a theft or an attempted theft from October 2022 to April 2023.

To illustrate the gravity of the situation, let's consider the shocking occurrence where 20 different dollar stores in the Detroit area fell victim to robberies within a mere 22-day span earlier this year. Compounding the problem is the increasingly menacing trend of organized retail crime, whereby groups collaborate to pilfer from retail establishments, posing a mounting threat.

According to the National Retail Federation, this form of retail theft surged by 26.5% in 2021 and displays no indication of decelerating anytime soon.

Just like last year, CNN is rating Pennsylvania one of the closest Senate races in the country.
#
Derek,
My friend Bob Casey is Pennsylvania through and through -- and I’m proud to stand up for working people + PA families alongside him in the Senate.
**But Mitch McConnell and the GOP are doing everything they can to defeat him and flip PA red next year.** 😧
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230830-1?refcode=em20230830-1-8533&refcode2=8533_434096_itc7-C&akid=8533%2E434096%2Eitc7-C)
CNN is rating Pennsylvania one of the closest Senate races in the country. Saving our razor-thin Democratic majority could all come down to reelecting Bob Casey, and all eyes will be on the Keystone State.
**[If we’re gonna keep the Senate blue, we need to come together to help Bob win this race. Please, split a contribution between our campaigns today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230830-1?refcode=em20230830-1-8533&refcode2=8533_434096_itc7-C&akid=8533%2E434096%2Eitc7-C)**

In 2022, we proved that a people-powered team can overcome their super PAC money, but with the race this close, we have to build grassroots strength in all 67 counties now if we’re going to win.

subject: OLCV's 2023 Photo Contest Deadline Tomorrow!
body:
| | | Dear Peter, If you sent us photos and entered OLCV’s Photo Contest already, thank you! We received an incredible 385 photos from all over the state featuring Oregon’s many natural wonders and diverse communities. Below is one that we got last week from Kathleen Worley, who sent in a photo of a Trailkeepers of Oregon group as “an example of the spirit of survival and renewal - the trees that made it through the Gorge fire, the people who volunteer their time and skill so that trails can be reopened as green ferns find their way through the ashes.” **The last day to enter the photo contest is August 31st, so if you haven’t yet, you have until tomorrow to send up to three photos to respond@olcv.org with “Photo Contest” in the subject line.** The winners will be announced in early September. Thank you! Jane Kwon
Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

I've always been a numbers person, I run my campaigns with the knowledge of where we've been, how we got there, and what we need to do to achieve our goals.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=652%2E135344%2EQBnbvV)

Friends --
I've always been a numbers person, I run all my campaigns with the knowledge of where we've been, how we got there, and what we need to do to achieve our goals.
So let's start at the beginning -- when I first ran for office in **2018:**
1,500 volunteers made up the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest. 200,000 doors knocked, 1 million phone calls and texts to get out the vote and a **13,098** vote victory.
Then on to **2020** , where COVID completely upended campaigning as we know it:
Nearly 2,000 volunteers, many virtual. Over 50,000 informational flyers left at doors (since we weren’t knocking doors during the pandemic), and again nearly 1 million phone calls to get out the vote. We won by **15,412**. Thank you independent voters of Michigan!
Then on to **2022** , where we had a brand new district to compete in, going from 2.5 counties to 7.
Again nearly 2,000 volunteers knocked on 85,000 doors and made more than 670,000 phone calls. This time we won by our largest margin, by **20,184** votes.
**Now we're into the 2024 cycle,** where I'm running for United States Senate to represent the whole state of Michigan.
Everything will be larger: We're going from 7 counties to 83 counties. We'll have a more extensive field campaign, requiring more volunteers, more doors knocked, more phone calls and texts, and yes... more money raised.
So today, we’re asking for your early support to help us build the financial foundation we’ll need to scale up our campaigning and win this race.

| | Peter,
---
| I’m excited to announce that Washington’s 47th Legislative District Republicans have endorsed my candidacy to serve in Congress!

The 47th Legislative District Republicans spearhead community gatherings and events to encourage active participation in our electoral process, educating voters on the candidates and the issues, and supporting Conservative legislation like upholding the rule of law, parental rights in education, responsible government spending, and individual freedoms.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=6c37d7d631&e=0e51d1e991)
---
| I’m deeply honored to have the support and endorsement from Washington’s 47th Legislative District Republicans. I have had a long history of involvement as a volunteer with fellow Republicans in the 47th LD. I’m grateful for their volunteer work in the community that has created neighborhood relationships and helped build a culture of civic duty. This participation is essential in electing leaders who represent our values, educating fellow citizens on the issues we are voting on, and rallying support for initiatives that protect parental rights, uphold law and order, and promote government responsibility.

It is a great honor to receive the trust of Republicans I’ve served in the trenches with as an involved citizen for common sense laws, reasonable taxation, and the preservation of each person’s Constitutional rights. As Congresswoman, it will be humbling to represent the voices of grassroots Washingtonians who have dedicated their time and energy to encourage every member of the community to engage in our sacred duty in keeping our Constitutional Republic alive.

Peter, let’s succeed in the goal of empowering our Constitutional Republic to endure. Join me in this mission to make sure the voice of We The People is heard, and our representative government responsive to its citizenry!

It is a great honor to receive the trust of Republicans I’ve served in the trenches with as an involved citizen for common sense laws, reasonable taxation, and the preservation of each person’s Constitutional rights. As Congresswoman, it will be humbling to represent the voices of grassroots Washingtonians who have dedicated their time and energy to encourage every member of the community to engage in our sacred duty in keeping our Constitutional Republic alive. Peter, let’s succeed in the goal of empowering our Constitutional Republic to endure. Join me in this mission to make sure the voice of We The People is heard, and our representative government responsive to its citizenry! | "ENDORSE GOERS FOR CONGRESS »" | "CONTRIBUTE TODAY »" | For Washington, | | Carmen Goers Candidate for U.S. Congress, WA-8 | | | | | | | | | | | | "Paid for by Carmen for Congress" | | Copyright © 2023 Carmen for Congress, All rights reserved.

* Releasing Terrapins 🐢 back into their natural habitat with with the state environmental service
* Meeting with county and municipal officials at the Maryland Associations of Counties Conference (and enjoying all the crab 🦀 Ocean City has to offer!)
* Visiting the 🚑 Maryland Department of Emergency Management to get to know the folks who are on the frontlines when emergencies happen in our state – like the big storm earlier this month that knocked out power for nearly 100,000 BGE customers

Teammates,
As summer comes to a close, my schedule has been _packed_ these last two weeks. And I wanted to share some highlights:
* Went to the Ravens' and Commanders' training camps 🏈 – I'm making the case that the Commanders should continue to play and _win_ in PG county
* Visited the 🏥 Women's Health Center in Western Maryland to thank them for all they do – they moved here after West Virginia banned virtually all abortion care
* Attended the Maryland Associations of Counties Conference in the beautiful Ocean City 🦀 – I'm building partnerships with our local electeds and doing the work to get our economy growing and make this Maryland's decade
* Took Tucker 🐶 to the SPCA of Anne Arundel's puppy plunge – we made some great new friends who are adorable AND adoptable

Now, I'm proud of all that travel, and I wouldn't change it for the world. Because it's how I fulfill my role as governor of Maryland and make sure we leave no one behind.
**But... It means we haven't been hitting our fundraising as hard as we could. And that's not something we can afford to leave behind either, team.**
[**So I'm asking you right now to pitch in and help close our fundraising gap before August is over. | Peter -
As one of my most loyal and committed supporters, I wanted to send a quick note before the August fundraising deadline to express my gratitude for your generous help.
I know that this time of the year you are being bombarded with fundraising emails, text messages, phone calls, and everything else from politicians asking you to donate to their campaigns.
I am sure it can be overwhelming, and hard to tell who is being honest, who is using cheap tricks and gimmicks, who is communicating a positive vision, and, ultimately, who you should send your hard-earned money to.
My hope is that my messages to you have been useful and substantive, and that I've explained in detail how I use every dollar you send me to further our conservative movement. Let me share with you all that we've been able to accomplish TOGETHER thanks to your generous support.
We're able to communicate with millions of people across the country, with persuasive messaging on key issues that are at the heart of some of the most heated debates in America. I know our messaging campaigns on energy, climate change, border security, taking on the cartels, and so much more have brought more people to our side and that wouldn't be possible without your help.
We're able to hold our Crenshaw Youth Summit in Texas, attracting thousands of young, active Americans from across the country to Houston for a weekend of fun, informative discussions that are meant to persuade young people to join the conservative movement. I truly believe these Youth Summits are ensuring the continued success of our movement for generations to come.
And, importantly, I'm able to stay in Congress and fight for the issues that matter to you. I take my legislative work seriously in Washington, passing bills to boost American energy production, reduce government spending and waste, secure our border and destroy the Mexican drug cartels.

subject: How your support is helping us move closer to a sustainable future
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

Friend, At age 19 I walked into my Catholic college’s health clinic on Valentines Day. My period was late. The nurse walked into the exam room with my pregnancy test, congratulated me, and my stomach dropped to the floor. In shock, I walked out of the office and found my boyfriend. He could tell immediately that I had gotten news neither of us were ready to hear. I knew he wasn’t ready to be a father. I knew I was not ready to be a mother... I knew, deep down inside, that we did not stand a chance of raising a family together. I had a medical abortion at 6 weeks pregnant. I was confused when I was not depressed or sad afterwards, but relieved. My limited education of abortion had only given me the sense that all women who make this decision would be swallowed by regret for the rest of their lives. Up until this point I had identified as “Pro-life.” I grew up going to Catholic school and went to a Baptist church on weekends. But more than God or religion, what made me pro-life was my mother. My mother was a teen mom, and I had always told myself that If I ever found myself pregnant unexpectedly, I would do what my mother did. But my mother struggled. Young and with few resources, she had to work harder than _anyone_ I have ever known to support my brother and me. When I found out I was pregnant, the realities of my mother’s journey hit me square in the face. I was not ready to embark on that journey. I was in no place to provide for a child. My abortion experience changed me in a way I never saw coming, so much so that after I was recovered I interned at a Women’s health clinic in Atlanta that offered abortion services. In my role I would sit with women on the day of their abortion procedure. I helped them fill out their medical paperwork, I talked to them about the procedure, I offered them a compassionate ear, and I listened to their stories. I did this for two years. I have quite literally heard _hundreds_ of women’s stories on the day of their abortion procedure. That is why I am running for office; I know that when a woman walks into an abortion clinic, it is their saving grace. No one is there flippantly or gleefully. _**Women are there because they need to be.**_

A woman having an abortion is in a crisis. Whether the crisis is borne out of money, career, existing children, or tragically a violent conception or medical emergency, abortion is necessary healthcare. I have never been a fan of the term “choice.” People choose abortion like people choose car accidents. People can drive as safely as they can, and still, sometimes accidents happen. You can take any number of precautions in your life, but things will still happen that are out of your control. I am now a proud 35 year old single mother of a beautiful six year old daughter. I have just graduated from law school and work for a wonderful environmental non-profit. I have a children’s book coming out next year. And for the first time in my life, I do not have to work two jobs to make it and life is absolutely wonderful. _So why mess it up by running for office?_ Because if Louisiana’s current abortion laws had existed when I was 19, I would not have had the chance to build my life to a place where I was truly ready to provide for a child. The Louisiana State Legislature has [passed a law](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXTEBokwJ0izHXMWrpJl2hHxMFYkKnUFaILCcOQyL90ZV-1t6Mt8I-8S8h5qcAg7GjNzSgyGMkdUfUlLhaMwJGJeDfWUDjkmNISJ2SYxOklYFMhCWIyV4GdQSluSyr4UaHWk8ohMQRHoXQzCerYzoZmAa6Xsm3yUx0Mxx0FuKVMMVZHM1z2nLNp9K2e1YSU5mYus8ypA4MlfjGRoOyWysq2cYUMVptwUtmAAGFDRDMD1iIcG56US1jJGajh0Qelt41n70BOw7ktBeq5j02NWhpL-gkrVAyS1UKKPdrIo-Sa5TxNcZeXS1Uj3BHDw1bggNgt47w49Ep66H6AEfnMF4SMHR1FCxXjzIUdo3Dhj6XDjI/3z6/kTzO7s7GRAi82jD8lJTTCw/h2/J_6Ny0CoDOay9wUUxnct2EdtP2GEpoM2SlTwpHK30W0) stating that every woman who falls pregnant is forced to give birth. **Louisiana has the harshest abortion law in the country.** Too young or too old? Too bad. Too sick? Too bad. No partner? Too bad. Bad partner? Too bad. Financially struggling? Too bad. Rape? Too bad. Incest? Too bad. If anyone, doctor or otherwise, helps a woman have an abortion, they are liable to face up to 15 years in jail and 200k in civil penalties. **This is a disgrace to the women and families of Louisiana and we must dismantle Louisiana’s cruel abortion landscape before it is too late.**

clean_body: When I was 19, I had an abortion | | Friend, At age 19 I walked into my Catholic college’s health clinic on Valentines Day. My period was late. The nurse walked into the exam room with my pregnancy test, congratulated me, and my stomach dropped to the floor. In shock, I walked out of the office and found my boyfriend. He could tell immediately that I had gotten news neither of us were ready to hear. I knew he wasn’t ready to be a father. I knew I was not ready to be a mother... I knew, deep down inside, that we did not stand a chance of raising a family together. I had a medical abortion at 6 weeks pregnant. I was confused when I was not depressed or sad afterwards, but relieved. My limited education of abortion had only given me the sense that all women who make this decision would be swallowed by regret for the rest of their lives. Up until this point I had identified as “Pro-life.” I grew up going to Catholic school and went to a Baptist church on weekends. But more than God or religion, what made me pro-life was my mother. My mother was a teen mom, and I had always told myself that If I ever found myself pregnant unexpectedly, I would do what my mother did. But my mother struggled. Young and with few resources, she had to work harder than anyone I have ever known to support my brother and me. When I found out I was pregnant, the realities of my mother’s journey hit me square in the face. I was not ready to embark on that journey. I was in no place to provide for a child. My abortion experience changed me in a way I never saw coming, so much so that after I was recovered I interned at a Women’s health clinic in Atlanta that offered abortion services. In my role I would sit with women on the day of their abortion procedure. I helped them fill out their medical paperwork, I talked to them about the procedure, I offered them a compassionate ear, and I listened to their stories. I did this for two years. I have quite literally heard hundreds of women’s stories on the day of their abortion procedure. That is why I am running for office; I know that when a woman walks into an abortion clinic, it is their saving grace. No one is there flippantly or gleefully. Women are there because they need to be. | Watch my first campaign video here. A woman having an abortion is in a crisis. Whether the crisis is borne out of money, career, existing children, or tragically a violent conception or medical emergency, abortion is necessary healthcare. I have never been a fan of the term “choice.” People choose abortion like people choose car accidents. People can drive as safely as they can, and still, sometimes accidents happen. You can take any number of precautions in your life, but things will still happen that are out of your control. I am now a proud 35 year old single mother of a beautiful six year old daughter. I have just graduated from law school and work for a wonderful environmental non-profit. I have a children’s book coming out next year. And for the first time in my life, I do not have to work two jobs to make it and life is absolutely wonderful. So why mess it up by running for office? Because if Louisiana’s current abortion laws had existed when I was 19, I would not have had the chance to build my life to a place where I was truly ready to provide for a child. The Louisiana State Legislature has stating that every woman who falls pregnant is forced to give birth. Louisiana has the harshest abortion law in the country. Too young or too old? Too bad. Too sick? Too bad. No partner? Too bad. Bad partner? Too bad. Financially struggling? Too bad. Rape? Too bad. Incest? Too bad. If anyone, doctor or otherwise, helps a woman have an abortion, they are liable to face up to 15 years in jail and 200k in civil penalties. This is a disgrace to the women and families of Louisiana and we must dismantle Louisiana’s cruel abortion landscape before it is too late. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: or Thank you for support at this critical stage of our campaign. | | Hotter temperatures, extreme weather, and poor air and water quality are threatening our lives daily, Peter. Just consider the last few weeks: Hurricane Hilary threatened parts of the continent that seldom see much rain at all, let alone brace for a hurricane or tropical storm. It brought unprecedented rain and flooding, but thankfully amounted to less than we had braced for. The recent wildfire in Maui burned thousands of acres, destroyed important cultural sites, and killed at least 114 people — making it one of the deadliest fires in our nation's history. Fires are currently burning in many parts of the continental United States. For months, we've been seeing headlines about the impact of heat domes, the _new_ 'hottest day on record,' and the spike in ocean temperatures worldwide. 2023 is on track to be the hottest year on record. **There's no denying it.** Climate change is now an existential humanitarian crisis. I've led successful efforts to combat climate change and make our community safer before, and want to expand these projects and more in Congress.
Here in Los Angeles, I spent the summer months with my students on sizzling hot asphalt — _sometimes reaching 145 degrees_. Now, after advocating for safer conditions for our kids and LAUSD staff, Los Angeles schools are building more green spaces, electrifying all our buses, and committing to 100% renewable energy by 2030. This is just the beginning. **In Congress, I will fight to:**
* Hold the oil industry and polluters accountable;
* Electrify public transportation fleets;
* Create incentives for renewable energy development and use; and
* Combat heat islands through innovative green spaces and more shade.
