clean_body: We are facing an existential humanitarian crisis — climate change. | | | | Hotter temperatures, extreme weather, and poor air and water quality are threatening our lives daily, Peter. Just consider the last few weeks: Hurricane Hilary threatened parts of the continent that seldom see much rain at all, let alone brace for a hurricane or tropical storm. It brought unprecedented rain and flooding, but thankfully amounted to less than we had braced for. The recent wildfire in Maui burned thousands of acres, destroyed important cultural sites, and killed at least 114 people — making it one of the deadliest fires in our nation's history. Fires are currently burning in many parts of the continental United States. For months, we've been seeing headlines about the impact of heat domes, the new 'hottest day on record,' and the spike in ocean temperatures worldwide. 2023 is on track to be the hottest year on record. There's no denying it. Hey friends, I’ll be honest - for Democrats like me running for re-election, the first Republican presidential primary debate was all we needed to really start the 2024 campaign in earnest.
Just look at what Democrats are up against - a deep-pocketed national Republican Party throwing its weight around to enact their extreme policies, like a nationwide abortion ban and climate change denialism.
But the chilling part is that the Republican frontrunner didn’t even show up to take his place on primetime TV - because he didn’t have to . Donald Trump’s continued grip on the Republican Party means we’re going to have to push - in my race and in so many key races all across the country - if we’re going to win in 2024 and protect our democracy from a future with a criminal in the White House and a GOP-controlled Congress.
That’s why my team and I have set a goal to raise $3,000 online by midnight tomorrow, August 31st. Will you donate $5, $10, $15, or whatever is meaningful to you to help us build a strong re-election campaign and support Democrats around the country?
Trump’s absence may have been a reprieve for viewers like you and me, but it also meant he couldn’t be held accountable by other Republican candidates on that stage - a critical step if we’re going to break his stranglehold on voters and the GOP as a whole. His continued popularity is fuel for extreme candidates like my opponent - and other MAGA acolytes - to jump into races, even when their beliefs are too far-right for most Americans .
In order to take back our country from Trump and candidates like him, it’s up to Republicans to denounce candidates with extreme, anti-science, anti-democratic beliefs. And it’s up to Democratic candidates like myself to deliver resounding victories at the ballot box.
It’s why I need you to help me fend off my MAGA opponent and support other like-minded Democratic candidates in the coming months. Can you chip in any amount to help us reach our August goal?

By Mark Vargas and Scott Kaspar

It’s déjà vu all over again in Illinois, and the same Republican party establishment that supported the failed Richard Irvin for governor campaign, is now backing their choice for president. And like Irvin, their preferred candidate continues to struggle on the campaign trail and in the polls – making Ron DeSantis their new ‘Richard Irvin’, in yet another sad and embarrassing chapter for the IL GOP elites.

Looking back, the thought of Aurora mayor Richard Irvin running for governor as a Republican was laughable.

After all, he not only pulled
Democratic Primary ballots (https://twitter.com/markmaxwelltv/status/1471589397552320517?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in 2014, 2016 and 2020, but Irvin also spent years praising Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker (https://twitter.com/demgovs/status/1483091889607909379?s=61&t=PRMWA5ZjyteefflEsOtYwQ&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – referring to him as a “great friend and a great leader.”

What? But that’s not all.

In 2020, Irvin attended a Black Lives Matter rally, yelling,
“I can’t breathe!” (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QOyFraLPPLo&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a phrase often used by anti-police groups around the country.

But during the primary campaign, IL GOP leaders went out of their way to defend Irvin’s Republican credentials – if that’s even possible – including IL GOP chair Don Tracy and IL GOP national committeeman
Richard Porter (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=0000017e-6d5c-dbc8-a1ff-7d7dbf990000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – a close ally to Tracy and the chief architect of the Irvin campaign who also served as co-chairman and advisor during his gubernatorial campaign.

Irvin would go on to lose the primary election by an astonishing 43 points, despite billionaire Ken Griffin dumping $50 million into his campaign, and racking up over
60 endorsements (https://www.wcia.com/illinois-capitol-news/irvin-scores-60-gop-endorsements-as-financial-filings-show-early-warning-signs-in-bailey-campaign/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) from IL GOP leaders from across the state.

That’s right – 43 points.

Although Irvin had attracted a mega donor and support from IL GOP leaders from across the spectrum, he failed to attract any real attention on the campaign trail from the people who matter most: the actual voters.

Illinois grassroots Republicans – the most powerful constituency in the state had sent a message to establishment Republicans that was loud and clear – that Irvin’s campaign was “dead on arrival.”

And it was.

Although no one can question Gov. DeSantis’ Republican credentials – he’s been a great governor in Florida – they can question the strategy behind his failing campaign.

For the last few years, DeSantis was viewed as the future of the Republican party and the presumptive frontrunner for the Republican nomination for president because of his bold leadership as governor during the pandemic.

However, many forget that during the early days of the pandemic, DeSantis shut down the state; advocated for residents to social distance; wear face coverings and get vaccinated.

DeSantis even praised Dr. Anthony Fauci.

That’s right, it’s all true.

And just two days before the Illinois General Election in 2022, Ken Griffin – Irvin’s mega donor and IL GOP ally, gave an interview with
Politico (https://www.politico.com/news/2022/11/06/gop-megadonor-desantis-24-ken-griffin-00065274?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) where he said he was ready to back DeSantis for president.

But when DeSantis announced his campaign for president on Twitter many months later in May, the announcement was riled with glitches and audio issues, making it virtually impossible to hear the Florida governor make his big announcement.

For DeSantis and his campaign, it was a humiliating experience. But that was just the beginning.

Not only has DeSantis struggled in the polls, where he trails frontrunner President Donald Trump by over 40 points, but he’s failed to gain any traction at campaign events.

In a photo that went viral a month ago, DeSantis was seen speaking to an empty room in Iowa. And that’s not a good optic when you are running for president of the United States.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/opinion-how-the-il-gop-has-turned-gov-ron-desantis-into-their-own-version-of-the-richard-irvin-campaign-for-governor.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
GOP presidential candidate and Fl. Gov. Ron DeSantis speaks to an empty room in Iowa. (Source: X)

And where’s the IL GOP?

They’re
doubling down (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/don-tracy-publishes-memo-highlighting-gop-presidential-debate-avoids-trump-in-a-deliberate-diss-as-il-gop-officials-double-down-in-support-of-desantis-disastrous-campaign.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=43c2593321-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_05_23&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-43c2593321-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) on their support of DeSantis and advocating why he’s still the better alternative to President Trump and the better candidate in a head-to-head with President Joe Biden.

Makes one wonder if Illinois Republican leaders are intentional on picking the losing candidates because they actually don’t want to win. If they did, they would be rallying around the frontrunner.

They didn’t rally around the frontrunner during the Illinois Republican primary, and they are not rallying around the frontrunner in the Republican presidential primary, either.

Perhaps they are proving that whatever they touch dies – and the end game is not to win – the end game is to maintain status quo – and that’s their status as the party in the minority.

And that’s sad.

Mark Vargas is Editor-in-Chief of Illinois Review and a columnist with Newsmax. From 2007-2010, he served as a civilian in the Office of the U.S. Secretary of Defense, traveling to Baghdad, Iraq 14 times. | | Peter, when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and states across the country immediately began enacting draconian laws to control women’s bodies and choices, one thing became abundantly clear:

Reproductive freedom will be on the ballot in 2024.

Already we’re seeing so many shameful and heartbreaking impacts of extreme abortion bans — the rising infant mortality rate in Texas, the seventh-grader forced to become a mom in Mississippi. And safe havens for reproductive rights are becoming fewer and farther between: Right now, Virginia is the _only remaining state in the South without an abortion ban in place._

We’ve got to fight these unjust restrictions at the state level and in the courts, and there are activists on the ground across the country who are doing just that. But there’s one clear action that we can and must take at the federal level if we want to ensure women have bodily autonomy: Congress must codify the protections of _Roe_ into federal law.

I’m prepared to do that — I introduced the bipartisan Reproductive Freedom for All Act, and I’m pushing hard to get it passed.

**But I’m up for re-election next year, so if I’m going to keep fighting for reproductive freedom, I need to hold on to my seat — and Democrats need to hold on to our majority.**

clean_body: | | | Peter, when the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and states across the country immediately began enacting draconian laws to control women’s bodies and choices, one thing became abundantly clear: Reproductive freedom will be on the ballot in 2024. Already we’re seeing so many shameful and heartbreaking impacts of extreme abortion bans — the rising infant mortality rate in Texas, the seventh-grader forced to become a mom in Mississippi. And safe havens for reproductive rights are becoming fewer and farther between: Right now, Virginia is the only remaining state in the South without an abortion ban in place. We’ve got to fight these unjust restrictions at the state level and in the courts, and there are activists on the ground across the country who are doing just that. But there’s one clear action that we can and must take at the federal level if we want to ensure women have bodily autonomy: Congress must codify the protections of Roe into federal law. I’m prepared to do that — I introduced the bipartisan Reproductive Freedom for All Act, and I’m pushing hard to get it passed. It's clear as day that Democrats are more fired up than ever to elect pro-choice women.

We've seen Democratic pro-choice women defeat Republicans nationwide; anti-choice ballot initiatives have been overwhelmingly rejected by voters in not-so-blue states like Kansas and Ohio; Wisconsin elected pro-choice champion **Janet Protasiewicz** to their state Supreme Court (with EMILYs List's support!); and state leaders are fighting hard to pass pro-choice ballot measures.

**I've seen this kind of grassroots energy before — back in 1992**. That was the year EMILYs List grew our membership by 600%, elected four new women to the Senate, and elected _20_ to the House. It quickly became known as the "Year of the Woman."

We just need more resources to recruit, train, and support candidates to make those values into policy. Dear Peter, When I was considering running for Congress, we sat the family down at the kitchen table to talk it through. The thing I remember most about that conversation was a question from my nine-year-old daughter, Evie: **"Mom, if you do this, are people going to hate us?"** | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68935616/424581753/-926527472?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20230830_fr_courage_cand_sm_no_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjcyMjJhNDctNjY0Ny1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qktHz7ZQQmF2QaKzec08umFBZlKCVPLLk65rakV2OSw=)
---
The sad truth is, she had a point.
The response I gave is something that I repeat often now: That when you stand up for what you believe is right, there will always be people who will and won't like you. **Standing up means having the courage to be disliked.**
I’m running for Congress because we need to stand up for our democracy, our middle class, and our kids. And regardless of the emails or comments questioning my motivations or my ability to campaign and be a good mom (yes, that’s happened) – I’m not backing down.
**And I want to thank you for standing with me.** Every time I see someone pitch in $10 or get a kind response to one of our emails, it helps drown out the haters and detractors because I know we’re standing tall together.
[**So here’s the ask: Will you keep being the support system that keeps us going by chipping in your first donation of $5?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68935629/424581754/-926527472?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20230830_fr_courage_cand_sm_no_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjcyMjJhNDctNjY0Ny1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qktHz7ZQQmF2QaKzec08umFBZlKCVPLLk65rakV2OSw=)
(Can't chip in right now? That's ok! Talk to your friends and neighbors; spread the word about what we’re doing and why. Tell them we’re standing up for our way of life here in Northern and Upper Michigan - for our families and ourselves- and we’re not stopping any time soon.)
Together, we are setting an example for the next generation.
Gratefully,
Callie
Callie Barr
Candidate for Congress in Michigan’s First District

I’m desperately in need of your help. I’m fighting a war on two fronts.

In one battle theatre I’m fighting an opponent who has shown himself to be a fundraising JUGGERNAUT. In the first 36 hours after announcing his candidacy, he raised more than $2 million.

If that weren’t enough, a relatively new super PAC calling itself _“Lose Cruz”_ has made commitments to spend millions on _“good old-fashioned attacks”_ **to expose all my** _“deplorable actions and the consequences of them.”_

[**I need your help IMMEDIATELY.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=41d4cf59457448dba6712756aac2812d&_e=-AdA7XQ0fRdxhBwerhqoa768GepSZF_plVcpSGcExLnMzyLNo1yhsTy1mltxXdIr8ihIQoUANmgLTTe_NIiGpaImiRK2FqToAu8I9CGYuAPDSIABXjwBtvBGPQNpGPZNBS1TLzG4c18fnqhyo3Bx4LeHQUg0eyo_iiIMy-GRmmJC34irUZTEz0HhMVokIvt_7uDTylUGf52Setx-8X38Y6i7hnPs3zQeG-n7iomAAAE4_AGrB79mqqibWs3DdGKWhuvXoQR7-3lGv0xwAR_JIHW4D772EBpYljnJBJuVrtO1ntaiI1bnhK6BdaBfshgq6rKiwxqvySaCQzEgeJ0Qa3prASEoy6pIEBKkqblaXgb_c5bMlz2AWWWgk0dYo0RpL1kXCeaIopqaNe2klsvxjurqC78trC5YLCOTmMKz7IfUlL7Pc1p2xG_E1znk7nTx)

**This is SERIOUS.**We cannot win back the Senate majority without a win in Texas.****

**Democrats are putting up a far-left candidate they think has enough wide-ranging appeal to beat me. What’s more, they’re putting their money where their mouth is.**

I don’t want to alarm you, but it’s critical we step up our fundraising game NOW. I’m going to need MILLIONS to defend myself from the never-ending attacks against me. Should we fail to rise to the occasion, I could very well lose this Senate seat.

My life’s work has been around one central question: What’s happening to hardworking people in America? What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep — and even rockier and steeper for people of color? Well, here’s the answer: It wasn’t an accident. It was because a series of decisions changed who Washington actually works for. I saw a government that only worked great for those with money and power — for those who could hire armies of lobbyists and lawyers. Corruption, pure and simple. So I got in the fight. I’m fighting for a government that works for families trying to make it payday to payday without getting ripped off — not just giant financial institutions. I’m fighting for a government that works for people trying to fill a prescription — not just giant drug companies. I’m fighting for a government that works for everyone who sees the climate crisis bearing down on us — not just Big Oil. I’m fighting for a government and an economy that works for everyone. That means running for re-election to pass more of the big, bold action we need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, and an end to Washington corruption. Here’s how I see this: We need to keep making bold change as a country. Not a nibble here, a piece over there. Big, systemic change. The kind of change that will make this government reflect the will of the people.
We’ve seen what we can accomplish when the American people elect champions for working families.
We overcame swarms of financial industry lobbyists to create the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which has put $16 billion back in the pockets of Americans who’ve been cheated.
We beat Big Pharma by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices for the first time.
We passed the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change, which is set to lower carbon emissions by 40 percent.
I’ll be the first to say there’s more we’ve got to do, including codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law. If we can come together and expand our Senate majority, and if we can take back the House, we can make more transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth, but as an unapologetic Democratic majority.
So I’m running for re-election to stay in the fight.

clean_body: To help build a future that works for working people, can you grow our campaign with a donation today? | | | My life’s work has been around one central question: What’s happening to hardworking people in America? What’s happening to hollow out America’s middle class? Why has the road to economic security gotten so rocky and steep — and even rockier and steeper for people of color? Well, here’s the answer: It wasn’t an accident. It was because a series of decisions changed who Washington actually works for. I saw a government that only worked great for those with money and power — for those who could hire armies of lobbyists and lawyers. Corruption, pure and simple. So I got in the fight. I’m fighting for a government that works for families trying to make it payday to payday without getting ripped off — not just giant financial institutions. I’m fighting for a government that works for people trying to fill a prescription — not just giant drug companies. I’m fighting for a government that works for everyone who sees the climate crisis bearing down on us — not just Big Oil. I’m fighting for a government and an economy that works for everyone. That means running for re-election to pass more of the big, bold action we need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, and an end to Washington corruption. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Here’s how I see this: We need to keep making bold change as a country. Not a nibble here, a piece over there. Big, systemic change. The kind of change that will make this government reflect the will of the people. We’ve seen what we can accomplish when the American people elect champions for working families. We overcame swarms of financial industry lobbyists to create the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, which has put $16 billion back in the pockets of Americans who’ve been cheated. We beat Big Pharma by allowing Medicare to negotiate for lower prescription drug prices for the first time. We passed the biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change, which is set to lower carbon emissions by 40 percent. I’ll be the first to say there’s more we’ve got to do, including codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law. If we can come together and expand our Senate majority, and if we can take back the House, we can make more transformational change — not just by the skin of our teeth, but as an unapologetic Democratic majority. So I’m running for re-election to stay in the fight. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate All content © 2023 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

| Friend –

When things get crazy, I find it helpful to make lists of everything I have to get done, whether it be at home, the office, or out in the district. Since I find lists helpful, I figured maybe you do too. That’s why I wanted to share a short list of _three reasons why I need your support right now:_

1\. **Voting rights** in North Carolina are at stake, and I’ll continue fighting for every eligible voter to have their voice heard. Voters should choose their representatives, not the other way around.

2\. **Women’s reproductive rights** continue to be rolled back, and as a husband and a father, I can’t let this power grab by the far right continue. Not when it comes to women’s autonomy over their bodies, essential health care, and the future of my daughter and women across the country.

3\. **Reaching this fundraising goal sends the message** that our campaign has momentum behind it. Bo Hines and the far right will do everything they can to unseat me. Reaching this goal and putting out strong numbers helps them know exactly how strong our movement is.

So, as I cross things off my to-do list, I hope you’ll add one thing to yours: donating to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project before tomorrow. clean_body: Help mitigate their voter suppression attempts, ensure voters have the resources they need to access the ballot box, and protect our democracy. | | | Brian Kemp and Brad Raffensperger have long, shameful records of voter suppression. Most recently, Raffensperger announced his plan to remove over 191,000 “inactive” voters from the rolls in August and move 184,000 more to “inactive” in future elections — disproportionately targeting Black and brown voters. That’s why we launched a new voter protection fund to fight back. = | = And if you want to learn more, here’s just a snapshot of their anti-voter records: As Georgia Secretary of State from 2010 to 2018, Brian Kemp: ❌ Said he was concerned with Democrats “registering all these minority voters;” ❌ Investigated more than 10 Black women for so-called “voter fraud” and charged them with felonies, which were later dropped due to lack of evidence; ❌ Put registrations for 53,000 voters on hold before the 2018 election, nearly 70% of which were Black voters; ❌ Supported consultants who advised counties on how to close precincts and polling places, resulting in Georgia counties closing a total of 214 polling locations — a higher percentage than in any other state; ❌ Canceled more than 1.4 million voters’ registrations by the end of his tenure, according to reports from the AJC. As Governor of Georgia from 2019 to today, Brian Kemp: ❌ Signed SB 202 to impose burdensome voter ID requirements, criminalize handing out food and water to voters in line, permit mass voter challenges, place unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes, and give Republican legislators the power to take over county Boards of Elections; ❌ Signed SB 441 to allow the Georgia Bureau of Investigations to investigate allegations of voter fraud and election crimes, feeding into Donald Trump’s false claim that the 2020 election was stolen; ❌ Signed SB 222, which criminalized hardworking elections officials and denied them necessary funds for our elections; ❌ Signed SB 92, which created a state commission to target and remove democratically elected district attorneys; ❌ Signed three pieces of legislation in 2023 alone aimed at taking over county Boards of Elections that have resulted in the removal of lawfully appointed Black members and Democrats from their ranks. As Georgia Secretary of State from 2018 to today, Brad Raffensperger: ❌ Purged 309,000 voters — 4% of all Georgia voters — from the rolls in 2019, ahead of the upcoming presidential election cycle; ❌ Purged another 100,000 voters from the rolls in 2021, ahead of the upcoming midterm election cycle; ❌ Expressed his support for “a set of reforms to current national election law” in a letter to former Speaker Kevin McCarthy, like strict voter ID laws and bans on the secure practice of third-party ballot collection; ❌ Supported SB 202, a law that made it easier for private citizens to submit mass voter challenges. This led to the challenging of 92,000 voters’ registrations in 2022; ❌ Attempted to block Saturday voting, causing confusion among voters and contradicting previous guidelines, during last year’s critical Runoff election cycle; ❌ Told reporters after the 2020 election, “I wish [Trump] would have won, and especially in Georgia. I certainly cast my vote for him;” ❌ Announced his plan to purge over 191,000 “inactive” voters from the rolls and move 184,000 more to “inactive” status. = = Thank you for your support, The Fair Fight Team | * 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2023 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We need your help to be prepared.
#
We’ll cut to the chase:
Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is quickly approaching and in order to reach our $350,000 goal, we need to raise exactly $26,219 by midnight tomorrow.
Alexandria already has a MAGA Republican opponent and we know Wall Street and other corporate interests will also spend big against Alexandria in 2024. **We need to be prepared.**
**Will you donate $5 right now with your personal link to ensure we can run a strong re-election campaign to keep Alexandria in Congress, fighting for a brighter future for all of us?**
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230830?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230830.ApgLEf&personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20230830-4903-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4903%2E2526796%2ECzIvuv)
Alexandria is working tirelessly to pass progressive policies in Congress, build resources to make local and community-focused impact, and continue growing this movement for change. **But Alexandria can’t do this work alone. She needs a movement alongside her.** _And you are a critical part of that movement._
We still have a gap before we reach our $350,000 fundraising goal, but if everyone who is reading this email chips in $5 — or anything they can today — we’ll be able to catch up. That’s the power of a grassroots, people-powered movement.
**If you’re able, will you use your personal link below to make a $5 contribution today?**
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230830?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230830.ApgLEf&personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20230830-4903-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4903%2E2526796%2ECzIvuv)
Together, we’ll keep fighting for progress.
Pa’lante,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230830?refcode=em20230830-4903-P_FND_EGR_GFM&t=3&refcode2=4903_2526796_CzIvuv&akid=4903%2E2526796%2ECzIvuv)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20230830-4903-P_FND_EGR_GFM&t=4&akid=4903%2E2526796%2ECzIvuv)**

Email us: [speak@ocasiocortez.com](mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

Hi team – it’s Andrea!
I just received this note (see below) from my campaign manager, Natalie, and so I wanted to reach out. **Bottom line: It looks like we’re still running $3,994 short of our end-of-month fundraising goal.**

Every dollar we raise this month will go towards fueling our voter outreach, funding our TV and digital ads, and building the campaign operation we need to win and deliver for Oregon families. **And with so much on the line in this election, we can’t risk coming up short.**

I need your help this month (and until Election Day) to ensure I can stay, fighting for you and your family, in Congress. So please: Can I count on your support before midnight tomorrow? Here’s a link they can use: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/salinas-august-23?refcode=AugustGoal**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68940270/424586940/-1509228828?refcode=em_fr_2023.08.30_b1_anm3_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjg2OTJkMi02ODQ3LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ilwc1s_BEsGXUx1VPa4dJNgH2cGrG7bWGv_bmsVygwk=)

All the best,

Natalie

body:

**The RNC Meeting, the First Presidential Debate, and ... I was in a Trump Campaign Ad!**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Last week, I traveled with Oregon's National Committeeman to the RNC Solomon Yue and Klamath County Republican Chair Rejeana Jackson to the RNC meeting and first presidential debate in Milwaukee, WI. No sooner had I reached the hotel and started to get comfy when the Trump campaign reached out and asked if I could represent Oregon in their new campaign ad. I appear in it twice. You can view the ad here:

[Listless Vessels - YouTube](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/muiTrsF1yUKDVJQcr_aZ7Q~~/AAAHUQA~~)
[Listless Vessels - Trump War Room on X](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/J9Ypip5KnExOVkRfkORNXQ~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgYzQwZTkxNDY5NmUyMTVkZWMyNzAzN2I1MWRhYzBjNzNEQGh0dHBzOi8vdHdpdHRlci5jb20vVHJ1bXBXYXJSb29tL3N0YXR1cy8xNjk0NDY3NjcxODc2NjQ0OTk3P3M9MjBXBXNwY2V1Qgpk6aGZ72RHA6LPUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABfYw~~)
The focal point of the week was, of course, the presidential debate. Solomon serves with Committee Chair David Bossie on the Presidential Debates Committee. Rejeana and I were able to sit in on part of their meeting (and others) before executive session started. In the end, any of the candidates on the stage would be better than Biden by a mile. I'm firmly on team Trump, but I do like some of the candidates ... and don't care much for still others. The audience was interesting to watch. Folks like Matt Gaetz and Chip Roy walked the aisles.

Each RNC member is allowed to take two guests to these meetings, and those guests are often former RNC members or representatives from national groups like the NRA, Turning Point USA and so on. A lot of business takes place in the days before and after - and in between - RNC committee meetings as so many participants are gathered together there anyway.

I've noticed that the RNC membership is divided between "establishment" and "grassroots." Solomon focuses on the work at hand; he was part of 4 of the 6 resolutions that passed. These resolutions can go on to become planks in RNC's platform, federal legislation, and even Republican presidential policy. We attended our first major league baseball game, which was simply a fun time for me and Rejeana. Solomon, though, used his time to lobby House Committee on Oversight and Accountability Chairman James Comer about taking his [Resolution to Hold Communist China Accountable](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/AgMfMqfLkZ-hqlBsoZ_PaQ~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgZDA3MzQ5ZDgwMGVkZjExMzY3NTJjYjUwZWUwYWE3ODJEVmh0dHBzOi8vcHJvZC1zdGF0aWMuZ29wLmNvbS9tZWRpYS8xLVJFU09MVVRJT04tVE8tSE9MRC1DT01NVU5JU1QtQ0hJTkEtQUNDT1VOVEFCTEUucGRmVwVzcGNldUIKZOmhme9kRwOiz1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) to the next step - federal legislation. When all was said and done, Oregon had a voice in the following successes:

* [Resolution to Protect Children from Unsafe Sex Trait Modification and Experimentation](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/-mD7905bFE02BzMBkiFGzw~~/AAAHUQA~~) (Drafted with Oregon State Rep. Ed Diehl, Sponsored)
* [Resolution to Put the Vital National Interest of the US First in Dealing with Communist China](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/vyAln4IqNdo12R14dDjX4w~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgMGMxOGIwZDQzZTFmNDA5NDg5MzgxMzFlOWMwYThmYTNEg2h0dHBzOi8vcHJvZC1zdGF0aWMuZ29wLmNvbS9tZWRpYS9SZXNvbHV0aW9uLXRvLVB1dC10aGUtVml0YWwtTmF0aW9uYWwtSW50ZXJlc3Qtb2YtdGhlLVVTLUZpcnN0LWluLURlYWxpbmctd2l0aC1Db21tdW5pc3QtQ2hpbmEucGRmVwVzcGNldUIKZOmhme9kRwOiz1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) (Co-Sponsored for Sponsor Patti Lyman)
* [Resolution Urging a - Return to Excellence - in American Voting and Elections](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/fpPnaumHmDCv2PsocaxWFg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgMzQ0ZDRhY2I4MGMxZGJiNDU2OGQzOGQxNjMzMGU0YjREb2h0dHBzOi8vcHJvZC1zdGF0aWMuZ29wLmNvbS9tZWRpYS9SZXNvbHV0aW9uLVVyZ2luZy1hLVJldHVybi10by1FeGNlbGxlbmNlLWluLUFtZXJpY2FuLVZvdGluZy1hbmQtRWxlY3Rpb25zLnBkZlcFc3BjZXVCCmTpoZnvZEcDos9SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAF9j) (Co-Sponsored for Sponsor Tyler Bowyer)
* [Urging the US Congress to Prohibit Foreign Ownership of Land Close to Military Bases](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/M0Y-ERvO2H8nQntUjdYJMw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgOTY2YWUyZGQ0MWQ4MmFkNGQ0NzA2YzkyNTVhOGJmOGVEemh0dHBzOi8vcHJvZC1zdGF0aWMuZ29wLmNvbS9tZWRpYS9VcmdpbmctdGhlLVVTLUNvbmdyZXNzLXRvLVByb2hpYml0LUZvcmVpZ24tT3duZXJzaGlwLW9mLUxhbmQtQ2xvc2UtdG8tTWlsaXRhcnktQmFzZXMucGRmVwVzcGNldUIKZOmhme9kRwOiz1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) (Co-Sponsored for Sponsor Gene Ward, assisted in drafting)

Finally, the RNC selected Houston, TX as the location of the 2028 national convention.
---
|
---
**Constitutional Carry Update**
---
---
Right after we announced that Constitutional Carry for Oregon (CCFO) had hit 10,000 signatures, a couple thousand more came in the mail! We'll update again when we hit a larger goal. 25% maybe?

* If you can't get to a signing location or event, just download the single-signer sheet at [**www.ConstitutionalCarryforOregon.com**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/WNROJOgfm11kOMLqK_TPlg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm0h6hP0UgNDU0NjRlMGY0YzVlMzlmMDgxNjZkNTc0NmZkMzUyOTBEK2h0dHA6Ly93d3cuQ29uc3RpdHV0aW9uYWxDYXJyeWZvck9yZWdvbi5jb21XBXNwY2V1Qgpk6aGZ72RHA6LPUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABfYw~~), print, sign, and mail it in!

* We STILL need help in Benton County!!!

* Have you used your Oregon tax credit yet? This is a CREDIT not a deduction. $50 per person donated to Constitutional Carry for Oregon will be immediately credited on your tax return just by checking a box on your tax return. If you don't donate, the State will take your money and use it toward all the things you don't want! Please consider donating to our cause today.

_When I look at the polls, when I look at our grassroots fundraising numbers, when I tour the country and am welcomed with such unbelievable love and patriotism, I am filled with endless motivation to NEVER SURRENDER our mission to save America._

name: Alex Padilla
subject: A simple question about climate change...
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
You’d think this would be an easy one for the GOP to answer
#

Friend,
At last week’s Republican presidential debate, the moderator asked a simple question: _Do you believe human behavior is causing climate change?_
Pretty straightforward, right? Given the overwhelming scientific consensus, you’d think this would be an easy one for them to answer.
But here’s what happened: **almost every candidate on that stage denied the reality of climate change, calling it a “hoax” or pivoting to attack Joe Biden.**
Honestly, it’s disappointing, but it’s not surprising. And for me, it only emphasizes how important it is that Democrats hold the Senate and re-elect Joe Biden in 2024.
Because if the GOP wins, they will _immediately_ start rolling back the progress we’ve made in California and across the country fighting the climate crisis.
That’s why I’m doing everything I can to stop that from happening, including traveling the country to support Senate Democrats and President Biden.
But here is the truth: in order to make sure we win, we need all hands on deck. And so I’m asking you to stand up and get involved.
[**If you can afford it, please make a $5 contribution to support my work to hold the Senate and re-elect President Biden. It would really mean a lot, especially before tomorrow’s end-of-month fundraising deadline.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-august23.UMf084&refcode=em230830-1-30&t=1&akid=1507%2E159979%2Ew-_q_H)**
**[DONATE $5](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-august23.UMf084&refcode=em230830-1-30&amount=5&t=2&akid=1507%2E159979%2Ew-_q_H)**
**[DONATE OTHER](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-august23.UMf084&refcode=em230830-1-30&t=3&akid=1507%2E159979%2Ew-_q_H)**
Thank you for everything,
Alex Padilla

I’m one of the GOP’s top targets in 2024.

That tells me one thing: **I must be doing something right.**

God Bless,

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As we’ve emailed you before, over the last year we’ve seen a sustained
slowdown in our fundraising. This has had a significant impact on our
organization – we needed to conduct layoffs last month to ensure our
financial stability for the future.

We will never scare you into donating or trick you with a fake triple
match like the DCCC. The sky isn’t falling and there’s no reason to kiss
all hope goodbye.

Instead, we will be honest about our fundraising slowdown and how it’s had
a material impact on our organization. Here’s a transparent look into the
fundraising slowdown we’ve seen:

We’ve made quite a few enemies over the last few years: Big Oil, AIPAC,
Republican Billionaires, and the political establishment on both sides of
the aisle.

But despite these challenges, we’re more fired up than ever to continue
pushing to transform the Democratic Party from the inside out, hold Biden
accountable to promises he’s made, and continue to challenge out-of-touch,
entrenched incumbents.

In order to continue this work we have to reach every fundraising goal
that we set for the remainder of the year. Right now we’re working towards
reaching our $87,000 end of month goal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137546?refcode=em20230830-30622&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30622%2E1203867%2EMNVEoB ]Will you make a $3 contribution right now to help us
continue to recruit progressive primary challengers who will fight for
issues like Medicare for All and a Green New Deal?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137546?refcode=em20230830-30622&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30622%2E1203867%2EMNVEoB ]Contribute $3

Thank you so much for your continued support,

Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=30622%2E1203867%2EMNVEoB ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=30622%2E1203867%2EMNVEoB ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Join me: Affirm the dignity of unhoused people! | |
---
Peter, I know what it’s like to be unhoused, living in a car with my two children. And I don’t want anyone else to experience that trauma and pain, which is why I’m working relentlessly on housing justice in Congress. **Two years ago, I led a 5-day action to extend the federal eviction moratorium as it was set to expire.** During our four nights and five days on the steps of the U.S. Capitol, I negotiated with the White House and Congressional leaders, and we succeeded in reinstating the ban on evictions -- keeping 11 million people in their homes. **But we must do more than prevent evictions.** We have a housing crisis including skyrocketing rents and increased homelessness, and our work won’t be done until we guarantee housing as a human right for every person in the country. **That’s why I have reintroduced the Unhoused Bill of Rights, affirming the dignity of unhoused people and laying out how we can end the unhoused crisis by 2027.** [**Please sign on today as a grassroots co-sponsor of my Unhoused Bill of Rights and ensure the government The legislation calls on the Department of Health and Human Services to declare the unhoused crisis a public health emergency, and calls for rigorous federal investments into affordable housing initiatives, assistance programs for people who are unhoused, and wraparound services that will keep people permanently housed. Thank you for taking action in support of our unhoused neighbors. With love, Cori Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress | | Sent via . Derek, I know I just reached out yesterday, but this is important.

My team and I set an ambitious end-of-month goal to raise $5,000 by tomorrow at midnight – but my finance director just informed me that we’re still falling behind.

I know 2024 seems far away – it feels like the last election was yesterday. But here’s the thing: Races like mine aren’t won in the home stretch. They’re won with a team of dedicated supporters who get in early to invest in the infrastructure of a winning movement.
**To be frank, if we’re not preparing for 2024, we’re losing.**
I’ll never stop being the science nerd and bipartisan problem-solver you elected. I’m going to keep fighting for more accessible paid family leave, more women and girls pursuing STEM fields, and commonsense solutions to gun violence. But these are divided times, and I can’t make progress without your support.

Friends —
Ayanna Pressley is one of the strongest champions for racial justice in Congress today.
She’s bold. She’s effective. She’s committed.
And that’s why clout-chasing Republican presidential candidates are attacking her.
Let us be clear: when someone calls a Black Congresswoman a leader of the modern KKK not only are they dead wrong but they are wielding deeply dangerous rhetoric, the kind of rhetoric that has cost Black folks their lives.
It would be laughable if it weren’t so serious. They’re trying to stir up animosity, seed violence, and get their faces on the news — any way they can.
Ilhan knows firsthand what it’s like to face these kinds of attacks from Republicans. We will never hesitate to call out their racism and bad-faith attacks when they happen, but we won’t be distracted.
Even as Republican candidates are invoking her name to fan the flames of white supremacy, we know Ayanna will stay focused on advocating and legislating to dismantle systems of oppression and advance racial equity.

MEMORANDUM TO: The NDRC’s Grassroots Supporters
FROM: John Bisognano, NDRC President
DATE: August 30, 2023

| | **URGENT ACTION REQUIRED: Demand federal action on the plastic crisis immediately before the planet is destroyed by the _PLASTIC APOCALYPSE._ **[**Take action and speak up now! >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1956157?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) While soaking up the last few weeks of summer, it’s easy to sit and daydream about what it must be like to be a sea turtle, enjoying the open ocean, drifting among the waves, gliding along the current... Although it may look like these iconic creatures are living their best lives, the sad truth is that these treasured marine critters are dying out rapidly. In fact, nearly all species of sea turtles are classified as **vulnerable or endangered** — meaning these beloved animals are at risk of __**EXTINCTION.**__ And do you know what one of the single biggest causes of sea turtles deaths is? _**HUMAN IMPACT**_ — including rampant plastic pollution which kills over a million marine animals every year. Plastics are taking over our oceans and the planet, and if we don’t step up immediately, scientists predict a _**PLASTIC APOCALYPSE**_ could destroy life on Earth as we know it. body:
In order to provide high-quality reporting without a paywall, we rely on grassroots donors like you to help fund our work.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1483%2E120351%2E85WcAB)
Peter,
The team here at Courier couldn’t be more excited about the big opening of our latest newsroom in Nevada! 🎉
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230830?refcode=em20230830&amount=5&refcode2=1483_120351_85WcAB&akid=1483%2E120351%2E85WcAB)
The Nevadan will join our network of newsrooms to provide reliable, fact-based, and accessible online reporting to communities across Nevada, including those in “news deserts.”
**And we’re looking to expand even further****, Peter. But in order to provide our high-quality reporting without paywalls, we rely on folks like you to help power our work.**
[**With our end-of-month fundraising deadline approaching fast, will you pitch in $5 or anything you can today to help us continue to grow and support our network of newsrooms?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230830?refcode=em20230830&amount=5&refcode2=1483_120351_85WcAB&akid=1483%2E120351%2E85WcAB)
**[Donate $5 now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230830?refcode=em20230830&amount=5&refcode2=1483_120351_85WcAB&akid=1483%2E120351%2E85WcAB)**
There are three big reasons your support is so important right now, Peter.
1. As Courier continues to **grow and expand to more states** , we’ll need to hire more journalists, lease more office space, and take on increased operating costs. Your contributions are critical to helping us get this done.

2. As the 2024 presidential election heats up, **the flow of misinformation is increasing**. body:
Elissa has always been honest and up front about the fact that we won’t use fake deadlines or scam-like tricks to get you to donate.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=654%2E135344%2EaZ845a)

Hello again -- Elissa has always been honest and up front about the fact that we won’t use fake deadlines or scam-like tricks to get you to donate. In an environment where candidates often send click-bait content to get a few bucks in the door, our mild and transparent approach has been getting noticed:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230830-2-30&t=2&akid=654%2E135344%2EaZ845a)
**[DONATE TO ELISSA](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-august23.skpj0d&refcode=em230830-2-30&t=3&akid=654%2E135344%2EaZ845a)**
So today, in the spirit of honesty and transparency, we’re asking you to consider chipping in to this Senate campaign in Michigan before tomorrow.
Here’s why:
Tomorrow at midnight we face our August monthly fundraising goal. And while this isn’t an official FEC public reporting deadline, it’s an important benchmark that we use internally to track our progress against what we know we need to raise to remain competitive in this race.
We’ve said it before, but starting strong gives us an ability to book TV ad time early and carve out an advantage in what is going to be one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.
That’s why we are asking for donations so far ahead of the election. Hearing directly from Coloradans is a critical part of how I do my job. Hearing your thoughts, concerns, and questions — whether in person or online — makes a difference in how I take on the biggest issues facing our state.
These were some of the key topics we discussed on Monday night:
*
Supporting
our
veterans:
We
need
to
make
sure
veterans
have
access
to
the
care,
services,
and
benefits
they
need
to
thrive
during
and
after
their
service.
The
PACT
Act,
which
we
passed
one
year
ago,
expanded
health
coverage
to
3.5
million
toxic-exposed
veterans.
It
was
the
biggest
expansion
of
health
care
for
veterans
in
decades
—
but
we
can’t
stop
there.
*
Fixing
our
broken
immigration
system:
In
2013,
I
was
part
of
the
Gang
of
Eight
who
came
together
to
create
and
pass
comprehensive
immigration
reform
through
the
Senate.
It
was
an
incredible
moment
of
bipartisanship
—
until
the
bill
was
blocked
by
far-right
Republicans
in
the
House.
Reforming
our
broken
immigration
system
is
possible,
and
I
will
work
with
any
Senator
to
come
up
with
a
solution
that
honors
both
our
history
as
a
nation
of
immigrants
and
the
rule
of
law.
*
Bipartisanship:
Citizens
United,
gerrymandering,
and
the
elimination
of
key
parts
from
the
Voting
Rights
Act
of
1965
have
created
a
system
that
allows
Republicans
to
play
“shutdown
politics.”
They’d
rather
block
any
chance
of
progress
than
come
to
the
table
and
work
on
solutions.
This
can’t
continue.
We
must
reform
our
campaign
finance
laws,
protect
our
democracy,
and
get
back
to
making
progress
for
the
American
people
—
and
I’ll
work
with
anyone
in
Washington
to
get
it
done.

body:
| | | | | | | | Friend,
This is MTG. I’m facing one of the most critical end-of-month deadlines of the year and we're still short of our $25,000 goal.
In the past year, Democrats have tried to strip my name off the ballot. . .
Democrat attorneys bankrolled by high-dollar left-wing donors even dragged me to court, forced me to “testify” hoping to throw me in jail. . .
**And although my name stayed on the ballot and I won in court, the Democrats succeeded in depleting my campaign defense funds after I had over a MILLION dollars in legal fees.**_****_
---
| [ ](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=b59319a27c&e=84ee529f47)
---
And with the arrest and mugshot of President Trump, we know one thing: The Democrats have painted a big red target on our backs and aim to throw us in jail.
_**Their attacks will NEVER stop.**_
| [ **DEFEND MTG - RUSH EMERGENCY DONATION** ](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=dd87224c1d&e=84ee529f47)
---
Unfortunately for them, I will always work harder and I won’t stop until we DEFEAT THE DEMOCRATS because I have the support of YOU – THE PEOPLE.
But I won’t lie to you –having to defend against the onslaught of vicious attacks and nasty smears has been costly.
And that’s exactly why the Democrats do it.
You see, this is the game they play:
They pick a target they need to silence.
They then throw everything they have to tarnish their name with media attack dogs and nasty articles. **They even deploy mobs of angry activists to our homes and harass us in public.**
And they use dark money donors like George Soros to bankroll radical DAs and other trial lawyers to target people like myself and President Trump.
One of their biggest tactics is to weaponize the legal system and force us to spend MILLIONS of dollars in campaign funds to defend ourselves so we can keep fighting to save this country.
**And now that I’ve beat them in court, I must replenish my campaign funds so I can go on the offense.**
[**Can I count on you to chip in $15 or more right now****?**](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=5823196cd5&e=84ee529f47)

---
Your donation gives me the ability to KEEP FIGHTING. It gives my campaign the resources to hire staff, make videos, and travel the country to spread the message of AMERICA FIRST.
_**And right now, I’m worried my campaign won’t reach our $25,000 end-of-month goal.**_
I know times are tough. So I’m only asking if you can absolutely afford to chip in at this time.
[**If $15 or more is too much, even a gift of $10 or just $5 goes a long way**](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=ba29c49d7d&e=84ee529f47).
I’m so thankful to Patriots like you for having my back.
None of this would be possible without you.
I’ll be in touch. _Your fellow patriot,_ Marjorie Taylor Greene

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

All of this work can only be done if we come together and use our collective power to fight for the progress we deserve.

Peter
We can not afford to ignore the absurdity that is the Republican party.
As our progressive movement fights to bring real solutions to the urgent crises we face, like climate action, trans and LGBTQIA+ rights, economic justice, and more — Republicans are off creating false new boogeymen and ignoring our real issues.
What we need is a people-over-politics centered legislature. **We need leaders in Congress who lead with compassion and care — and Pramila is that leader.**
That’s why it's crucial that in these final moments before the end of the month, we muster our collective power to support Pramila and boost our campaign’s resources.
**[Can we count on you to chip in $3 or more to help us boost our fundraising ahead of our August 31 fundraising deadline?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/44935?refcode=em20230830-2870&t=1&akid=2870%2E420207%2Es13IZ5)**

# We Can’t Miss This Deadline
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Dear Peter, You know that I’m running for President because I believe the American people deserve honest, transparent, and accountable leadership. So, I’m going to level with you. We have a major fundraising deadline coming up at the end of the month, and we’re dangerously close to falling short. We’re still $120,000 behind our goal, but with your help, we can get back on track. [**Please make your contribution of $5 or $10 – or if you can contribute more, that would make an even greater impact – in the next two days before the deadline is passed.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5bbfaf11a1&e=0be619cbaa) As I told Newsmax, the RNC essentially put our campaign on their [“terror watch list.”](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=9ad8fa4b8e&e=0be619cbaa) But that effort backfired. Our message was so powerful that [Nikki Haley](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=5094faaa88&e=0be619cbaa) and [Vivek Ramaswamy ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b1fd98da49&e=0be619cbaa)decided to use it as their own during the debate. After the RNC’s decision to exclude us, America First patriots like [Kari Lake ](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b14eb08b3f&e=0be619cbaa)and The Blaze’s [Jason Whitlock](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=b157025cd2&e=0be619cbaa) called them out. Since then, we’ve gained momentum. I appeared on [Glenn Beck’s show](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=14d94678bc&e=0be619cbaa) and on WABC in New York to discuss my campaign, and the RNC’s effort to silence us. Because they canceled us, **MILLIONS OF AMERICANS** have heard the independent conservative message the RNC doesn’t want them to hear. [**That message is clear: We’ve got a country to save. But I need your help to get there. Your donations and support allow us to confront the issues that are tearing our great country apart.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=6d0401228a&e=0be619cbaa) Conservatives need a candidate who’s willing to stand up to the liberal charlatans like Reverend Al Sharpton [pushing the lie of systemic racism](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=13113f6f77&e=0be619cbaa). Democrats won’t do it. The RNC is afraid that if they mention it, they’ll be called racist. But I’m not afraid, and I will always speak the truth. **I am the only candidate with the courage to confront these problems head on.** On day one, I’ll take the fight to liberal prosecutors on behalf of the hardworking, law-abiding Americans who make this country great, and take back our cities. I will prioritize school choice, giving every child, regardless of socioeconomic background, access to the education they deserve. I will reject the “equity” agenda pushed by social justice warriors and prioritize the freedom of every American, regardless of race, to realize their economic potential. I know that when Americans are freed to pursue a better life, anything is possible! Together, we defeat the radical liberal interests trying to tear our country apart, and the Republican Establishment that’s too scared to fight back. Together, we can usher in a new American Golden Age, and take our country back. **I am working hard for you, but we need your help soon. Our next fundraising deadline is rapidly approaching.** **[Will you stand with me? Your support helps us to get on that next debate stage, where we can take our appeal directly to the American people and confront the establishment head on. With your help, we can restore America!](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=aaa6b74f39&e=0be619cbaa)** Thank you,
Larry Elder
GOP Candidate for President

| | Earlier this month, President Biden marked a significant milestone by creating the Baaj Nwaavjo I'tah Kukveni – Ancestral Footprints of the Grand Canyon National Monument. Creating this monument conserves nearly 1 million acres of Tribal lands, preserves some of our state's most transcendent natural beauty, and sustains our progress to protect national landmarks against the impact of climate change. **This action isn't just for Arizona; it's a decision to safeguard our planet for generations to come.** I'm proud that my boys have seen the Grand Canyon, the Saguaro National Park, and Monument Valley, and I'm running for Congress to make sure that our parks and landmarks remain there for them and for _their_ children. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68957029/424621071/-1307231135?refcode=2023-08-30-monuments&recurring=0&amount=6&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=cbcf1e0c-8b47-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc0NDIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2JjZjFlMGMtOGI0Ny1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=e1umNLUg58k95s9keVsZpMXfw-swlUEFhrAfZYV-Y7w=) From land conservation to smarter water policies to new clean energy initiatives, I will be part of the solution. Meanwhile, David Schweikert stands in the way of the policies we need. Creating this monument conserves nearly 1 million acres of Tribal lands, preserves some of our state's most transcendent natural beauty, and sustains our progress to protect national landmarks against the impact of climate change. This action isn't just for Arizona; it's a decision to safeguard our planet for generations to come. I'm proud that my boys have seen the Grand Canyon, the Saguaro National Park, and Monument Valley, and I'm running for Congress to make sure that our parks and landmarks remain there for them and for their children. = From land conservation to smarter water policies to new clean energy initiatives, I will be part of the solution. I'll work with federal, state, and local partners to get things done for Arizonans and tackle the historic challenge of climate change. Meanwhile, David Schweikert stands in the way of the policies we need. He's repeatedly opposed efforts to expand clean energy — and he even voted against conserving land in Grand Canyon National Park. The longer David Schweikert is in office, the harder it's going to be to protect everything that makes Arizona special. So I hope you'll stand with me as I campaign to build a better future for Arizonans. = More soon, Conor | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for and authorized by Conor for AZ. |

Tragedies are unfolding as fires in Maui and across the country destroy homes, communities, businesses, and even worse, innocent lives—a consequence of faulty power lines and aging infrastructure built to the standards of the last century.

The death toll from the Maui fires has now surpassed the fatalities in California’s deadliest fire—and continues to mount. These fires resulted from deteriorating power poles and bare lines, vulnerable to sparks and incapable of withstanding hurricane winds.

Disturbingly, power companies and regulators already had this information and did nothing.
